## File: .github/workflows/godot-android-first-playable.yml
````yaml
name: Godot Android First Playable

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'godot/**'
      - 'tools/audio/**'
      - '.github/workflows/godot-android-first-playable.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'godot/**'
      - 'tools/audio/**'
      - '.github/workflows/godot-android-first-playable.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-godot-android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Generate original authored audio
        run: python3 tools/audio/generate_deadline_zero_audio.py

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: platform-tools

      - name: Install Android SDK components
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.1"

      - name: Download Godot 4.7.2 editor and matching export templates
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fL --retry 4 \
            https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip \
            -o /tmp/godot.zip
          curl -fL --retry 4 \
            https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_export_templates.tpz \
            -o /tmp/godot-templates.tpz
          unzip -q /tmp/godot.zip -d /tmp/godot
          chmod +x /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64
          rm -rf /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          mkdir -p /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          unzip -q /tmp/godot-templates.tpz -d /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable"
          cp -R /tmp/godot-template-unpack/templates/. "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable/"
          test -s "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable/android_debug.apk"

      - name: Configure Godot Android editor settings
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          keytool -genkeypair -v \
            -keystore /tmp/deadline-zero-debug.keystore \
            -storepass android \
            -alias androiddebugkey \
            -keypass android \
            -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Deadline Zero,C=FR" \
            -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/godot"
          cat > "$HOME/.config/godot/editor_settings-4.7.tres" <<EOF
          [gd_resource type="EditorSettings" format=3]

          [resource]
          export/android/android_sdk_path = "${ANDROID_HOME}"
          export/android/java_sdk_path = "${JAVA_HOME}"
          export/android/debug_keystore = "/tmp/deadline-zero-debug.keystore"
          export/android/debug_keystore_user = "androiddebugkey"
          export/android/debug_keystore_pass = "android"
          export/android/shutdown_adb_on_exit = true
          EOF

      - name: Import Godot project
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 \
            --headless --path godot --editor --quit

      - name: Export native Godot Android debug APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/godot-android
          /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 \
            --headless --path godot \
            --export-debug "Android Debug" \
            "$(pwd)/build/godot-android/deadline-zero-godot-debug.apk"
          test -s build/godot-android/deadline-zero-godot-debug.apk

      - name: Validate native APK package and architectures
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=build/godot-android/deadline-zero-godot-debug.apk
          AAPT="$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/35.0.1/aapt"
          test -x "$AAPT"
          "$AAPT" dump badging "$APK" > build/godot-android/badging.txt 2> build/godot-android/badging-stderr.txt || true
          grep -q "package: name='com.deadlinezero.godot'" build/godot-android/badging.txt
          unzip -l "$APK" | tee build/godot-android/apk-contents.txt
          unzip -p "$APK" 'classes*.dex' | strings | grep -q 'org/godotengine/godot/FullScreenGodotApp'
          grep -q 'lib/arm64-v8a/' build/godot-android/apk-contents.txt
          grep -q 'lib/x86_64/' build/godot-android/apk-contents.txt
          (cd build/godot-android && sha256sum deadline-zero-godot-debug.apk > SHA256SUMS.txt)
          (cd build/godot-android && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt)

      - name: Upload native Godot first-playable APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deadline-zero-godot-first-playable-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            build/godot-android/deadline-zero-godot-debug.apk
            build/godot-android/SHA256SUMS.txt
            build/godot-android/badging.txt
            build/godot-android/badging-stderr.txt
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  smoke-godot-android:
    needs: build-godot-android
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deadline-zero-godot-first-playable-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/godot-android

      - name: Enable KVM
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm

      - name: Set up Android SDK for smoke job
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: platform-tools

      - name: Smoke-test native Godot APK
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 35
          arch: x86_64
          profile: pixel_2
          emulator-options: -no-snapshot -no-window -gpu software -noaudio -no-boot-anim -camera-back none
          emulator-boot-timeout: 600
          disable-animations: true
          script: |
            set -eu
            mkdir -p build/godot-android-smoke
            # The emulator runner installs the matching system image and emulator.
            # Do not preinstall them: redundant sdkmanager installation can fail
            # before runtime smoke testing, even after the APK builds successfully.
            emulator -version > build/godot-android-smoke/emulator-version.txt 2>&1 || true
            adb version > build/godot-android-smoke/adb-version.txt 2>&1 || true
            adb wait-for-device
            timeout 300s bash -c 'until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r")" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done'
            # sys.boot_completed can flip before Launcher/overlay/display configuration has
            # finished settling on a cold API-35 emulator. Launching the forced-landscape
            # Godot activity during that window causes Android to destroy it when the final
            # portrait home-display configuration is published a few seconds later.
            adb shell input keyevent 3 || true
            adb shell wm dismiss-keyguard || true
            sleep 12
            timeout 30s sh -c 'until adb shell dumpsys activity top 2>/dev/null | grep -E "ACTIVITY com.android.launcher3|mResumedActivity.*com.android.launcher3" >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' || true
            adb shell input keyevent 82 || true

            # Boot the test display in landscape before Godot starts. Launching from the emulator's
            # portrait home screen makes Android recreate the activity during rotation; on SwiftShader
            # that teardown can exceed Godot's renderer shutdown timeout and kill an otherwise healthy app.
            adb shell settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0
            adb shell settings put system user_rotation 1
            timeout 20s sh -c 'until adb shell dumpsys display 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq "mCurrentOrientation=1|orientation=1|ROTATION_90"; do sleep 1; done' || true
            adb shell wm size > build/godot-android-smoke/display-before-launch.txt || true
            adb shell dumpsys display >> build/godot-android-smoke/display-before-launch.txt || true

            adb install -r build/godot-android/deadline-zero-godot-debug.apk
            adb shell pm path com.deadlinezero.godot | grep -q 'package:'
            adb shell dumpsys package com.deadlinezero.godot > build/godot-android-smoke/package-before-launch.txt || true
            printf '%s\n' 'android.intent.action.MAIN @ com.deadlinezero.godot' > build/godot-android-smoke/launch-component.txt
            adb shell settings put secure immersive_mode_confirmations confirmed || true
            adb logcat -c
            adb shell am force-stop com.deadlinezero.godot
            adb shell am start -W -a android.intent.action.MAIN -p com.deadlinezero.godot | tee build/godot-android-smoke/am-start.txt
            grep -Eq 'Status: ok|Complete' build/godot-android-smoke/am-start.txt

            timeout 30s sh -c 'until adb shell dumpsys activity top 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 "ACTIVITY com.deadlinezero.godot/com.godot.game.GodotApp" >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done'
            adb shell pidof com.deadlinezero.godot | grep -q .
            sleep 5

            # Guard against Android's first-use immersive tutorial obscuring visual QA.
            adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/deadline-zero-window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            adb pull /sdcard/deadline-zero-window.xml build/godot-android-smoke/window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            grep -q 'Viewing full screen' build/godot-android-smoke/window.xml 2>/dev/null && { adb shell settings put secure immersive_mode_confirmations confirmed || true; adb shell input keyevent 66 || true; sleep 2; } || true
            adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/deadline-zero-window-final.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            adb pull /sdcard/deadline-zero-window-final.xml build/godot-android-smoke/window-final.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            ! grep -q 'Viewing full screen' build/godot-android-smoke/window-final.xml 2>/dev/null

            adb exec-out screencap -p > build/godot-android-smoke/first-playable.png
            test -s build/godot-android-smoke/first-playable.png

            # Always persist runtime state before visual assertions so failures remain diagnosable.
            adb logcat -d -v threadtime > build/godot-android-smoke/startup-logcat.txt || true
            adb shell dumpsys activity activities > build/godot-android-smoke/activity-activities.txt || true
            adb shell dumpsys activity processes > build/godot-android-smoke/activity-processes.txt || true
            adb shell dumpsys activity exit-info com.deadlinezero.godot > build/godot-android-smoke/exit-info.txt || true
            adb shell dumpsys package com.deadlinezero.godot > build/godot-android-smoke/package.txt || true
            adb shell pidof com.deadlinezero.godot > build/godot-android-smoke/pid.txt || true

            test -s build/godot-android-smoke/pid.txt || grep -Ei 'deadlinezero|godot|FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|DEBUG|crash|signal|vulkan|swiftshader|am_crash|am_kill|am_proc_died' build/godot-android-smoke/startup-logcat.txt | tail -n 300 >&2 || true
            grep -q '[0-9]' build/godot-android-smoke/pid.txt
            adb shell dumpsys activity top > build/godot-android-smoke/activity-top.txt || true
            grep -m1 'ACTIVITY com.deadlinezero.godot/com.godot.game.GodotApp' build/godot-android-smoke/activity-top.txt
            ! grep -Eq 'FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in com\\.deadlinezero\\.godot|Process: com\\.deadlinezero\\.godot.*has died' build/godot-android-smoke/startup-logcat.txt
            # Android emulator software backends are not a reliable visual oracle for Godot 4.7:
            # Compatibility can hit upstream uniform-vector limits and Mobile/Vulkan may return
            # VK_INCOMPLETE from the headless emulator surface. This job therefore proves native
            # Android startup/lifecycle/foreground health, while Godot 3D Verify owns rendered-frame QA.
            grep -q 'Godot Engine v4.7.2' build/godot-android-smoke/startup-logcat.txt
            grep -Eq 'Forward Mobile|Vulkan .* Mobile' build/godot-android-smoke/startup-logcat.txt
            python3 -c 'import struct; from pathlib import Path; p=Path("build/godot-android-smoke/first-playable.png"); b=p.read_bytes(); assert b[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"; w,h=struct.unpack(">II", b[16:24]); assert w > h, f"expected landscape diagnostic screenshot, got {w}x{h}"; print(f"GODOT_ANDROID_DIAGNOSTIC_SCREENSHOT {w}x{h} bytes={len(b)}")'

            # Prove a normal Android background/foreground cycle. The process must survive Home
            # and the Godot activity must resume without an ANR/crash.
            adb shell pidof com.deadlinezero.godot > build/godot-android-smoke/pid-before-background.txt
            adb shell input keyevent 3
            sleep 3
            adb shell pidof com.deadlinezero.godot > build/godot-android-smoke/pid-background.txt
            test -s build/godot-android-smoke/pid-background.txt
            adb shell am start -W -a android.intent.action.MAIN -p com.deadlinezero.godot | tee build/godot-android-smoke/am-resume.txt
            grep -Eq 'Status: ok|Complete' build/godot-android-smoke/am-resume.txt
            timeout 30s sh -c 'until adb shell dumpsys activity top 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 "ACTIVITY com.deadlinezero.godot/com.godot.game.GodotApp" >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done'
            sleep 2
            adb shell pidof com.deadlinezero.godot > build/godot-android-smoke/pid-after-resume.txt
            test -s build/godot-android-smoke/pid-after-resume.txt
            adb logcat -d -v threadtime > build/godot-android-smoke/background-resume-logcat.txt || true
            ! grep -Eq 'FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in com\.deadlinezero\.godot|Process: com\.deadlinezero\.godot.*has died' build/godot-android-smoke/background-resume-logcat.txt

            # Prove clean process recreation from Android launcher state. This is intentionally a
            # force-stop/relaunch contract, not a claim that an in-progress run is restored.
            adb shell am force-stop com.deadlinezero.godot
            sleep 2
            adb shell pidof com.deadlinezero.godot > build/godot-android-smoke/pid-after-force-stop.txt 2>/dev/null || true
            test ! -s build/godot-android-smoke/pid-after-force-stop.txt
            adb logcat -c
            adb shell am start -W -a android.intent.action.MAIN -p com.deadlinezero.godot | tee build/godot-android-smoke/am-relaunch.txt
            grep -Eq 'Status: ok|Complete' build/godot-android-smoke/am-relaunch.txt
            timeout 30s sh -c 'until adb shell dumpsys activity top 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 "ACTIVITY com.deadlinezero.godot/com.godot.game.GodotApp" >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done'
            sleep 4
            adb shell pidof com.deadlinezero.godot > build/godot-android-smoke/pid-after-relaunch.txt
            test -s build/godot-android-smoke/pid-after-relaunch.txt
            adb exec-out screencap -p > build/godot-android-smoke/relaunch.png
            python3 -c 'import struct; from pathlib import Path; p=Path("build/godot-android-smoke/relaunch.png"); b=p.read_bytes(); assert b[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"; w,h=struct.unpack(">II", b[16:24]); assert w > h, f"relaunch lost landscape contract: {w}x{h}"; print(f"GODOT_ANDROID_RELAUNCH_SCREENSHOT {w}x{h} bytes={len(b)}")'
            adb logcat -d -v threadtime > build/godot-android-smoke/relaunch-logcat.txt || true
            ! grep -Eq 'FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in com\.deadlinezero\.godot|Process: com\.deadlinezero\.godot.*has died' build/godot-android-smoke/relaunch-logcat.txt
            echo "GODOT_ANDROID_LIFECYCLE_OK background_resume=1 process_relaunch=1"

      - name: Upload native Godot startup diagnostics
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: deadline-zero-godot-smoke-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/godot-android-smoke/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
````

## File: .github/workflows/godot-firebase-physical-qa.yml
````yaml
name: Godot Firebase Physical QA

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      device_model:
        description: Firebase Test Lab physical MODEL_ID (query the live catalog first)
        required: true
      android_version:
        description: Test Lab OS_VERSION_ID supported by the selected physical model
        required: true
      timeout:
        description: Robo smoke timeout
        required: true
        default: "120s"

concurrency:
  group: godot-firebase-physical-qa
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  physical-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Require Firebase physical-QA configuration
        env:
          PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_TEST_LAB_PROJECT_ID }}
          SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_TEST_LAB_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$PROJECT_ID" || { echo "::error::Missing FIREBASE_TEST_LAB_PROJECT_ID"; exit 1; }
          test -n "$SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON" || { echo "::error::Missing FIREBASE_TEST_LAB_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON"; exit 1; }

      - name: Authenticate Google Cloud
        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3
        with:
          credentials_json: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_TEST_LAB_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}

      - name: Set up gcloud
        uses: google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@v3
        with:
          project_id: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_TEST_LAB_PROJECT_ID }}

      - name: Generate original authored audio
        run: python3 tools/audio/generate_deadline_zero_audio.py

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: platform-tools

      - name: Install Android SDK components
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.1"

      - name: Download Godot editor and Android templates
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fL --retry 4 \
            https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip \
            -o /tmp/godot.zip
          curl -fL --retry 4 \
            https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_export_templates.tpz \
            -o /tmp/godot-templates.tpz
          unzip -q /tmp/godot.zip -d /tmp/godot
          chmod +x /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64
          rm -rf /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          mkdir -p /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          unzip -q /tmp/godot-templates.tpz -d /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable"
          cp -R /tmp/godot-template-unpack/templates/. "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable/"

      - name: Configure Godot Android export
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          keytool -genkeypair -v \
            -keystore /tmp/deadline-zero-debug.keystore \
            -storepass android \
            -alias androiddebugkey \
            -keypass android \
            -dname "CN=Deadline Zero Firebase QA,O=Deadline Zero,C=FR" \
            -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/godot"
          cat > "$HOME/.config/godot/editor_settings-4.7.tres" <<EOF
          [gd_resource type="EditorSettings" format=3]

          [resource]
          export/android/android_sdk_path = "${ANDROID_HOME}"
          export/android/java_sdk_path = "${JAVA_HOME}"
          export/android/debug_keystore = "/tmp/deadline-zero-debug.keystore"
          export/android/debug_keystore_user = "androiddebugkey"
          export/android/debug_keystore_pass = "android"
          EOF

      - name: Build native Godot QA APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 --headless --path godot --editor --quit
          mkdir -p build/firebase-physical
          /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 \
            --headless --path godot \
            --export-debug "Android Debug" \
            "$(pwd)/build/firebase-physical/deadline-zero-physical-qa.apk"
          test -s build/firebase-physical/deadline-zero-physical-qa.apk

      - name: Validate selected physical Test Lab device
        env:
          MODEL: ${{ inputs.device_model }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.android_version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gcloud firebase test android models describe "$MODEL" --format=json \
            > build/firebase-physical/device-model.json
          test -s build/firebase-physical/device-model.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          data = json.loads(Path("build/firebase-physical/device-model.json").read_text())
          blob = json.dumps(data).upper()
          model = os.environ["MODEL"]
          version = os.environ["VERSION"]
          assert "PHYSICAL" in blob, f"{model} is not reported as a physical Test Lab device"
          versions = data.get("supportedVersionIds") or data.get("supported_version_ids") or []
          assert str(version) in {str(v) for v in versions}, (
              f"Android version {version} is not supported by {model}; supported={versions}"
          )
          print(f"FIREBASE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_OK model={model} version={version}")
          PY
          cat build/firebase-physical/device-model.json

      - name: Run no-cost physical Robo smoke
        env:
          MODEL: ${{ inputs.device_model }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.android_version }}
          TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.timeout }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gcloud firebase test android run \
            --type=robo \
            --app build/firebase-physical/deadline-zero-physical-qa.apk \
            --device "model=${MODEL},version=${VERSION},locale=en,orientation=landscape" \
            --timeout "$TEST_TIMEOUT" \
            --client-details "matrixLabel=DeadlineZero-${GITHUB_SHA::8}" \
            --results-history-name "Deadline Zero Physical QA" \
            --format=json \
            | tee build/firebase-physical/test-lab-result.json
          test -s build/firebase-physical/test-lab-result.json

      - name: Upload physical QA evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: deadline-zero-firebase-physical-qa-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            build/firebase-physical/deadline-zero-physical-qa.apk
            build/firebase-physical/device-model.json
            build/firebase-physical/test-lab-result.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
````

## File: .github/workflows/godot-play-aab-verify.yml
````yaml
name: Godot Play AAB Verify

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'godot/**'
      - 'tools/audio/**'
      - 'tools/audio/**'
      - '.github/workflows/godot-play-aab-verify.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'godot/**'
      - '.github/workflows/godot-play-aab-verify.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify-play-aab:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Generate original authored audio
        run: python3 tools/audio/generate_deadline_zero_audio.py

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: platform-tools

      - name: Install Android 16 SDK for current Play target policy
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;35.0.1" "cmdline-tools;latest" "cmake;3.10.2.4988404" "ndk;28.1.13356709"

      - name: Download Godot 4.7.2 editor and export templates
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fL --retry 4 \
            https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip \
            -o /tmp/godot.zip
          curl -fL --retry 4 \
            https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_export_templates.tpz \
            -o /tmp/godot-templates.tpz
          unzip -q /tmp/godot.zip -d /tmp/godot
          chmod +x /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64
          rm -rf /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          mkdir -p /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          unzip -q /tmp/godot-templates.tpz -d /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable"
          cp -R /tmp/godot-template-unpack/templates/. "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable/"
          test -s "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable/android_release.apk"
          test -s "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable/android_source.zip"

      - name: Configure Godot Android SDK paths
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/godot"
          cat > "$HOME/.config/godot/editor_settings-4.7.tres" <<EOF
          [gd_resource type="EditorSettings" format=3]

          [resource]
          export/android/android_sdk_path = "${ANDROID_HOME}"
          export/android/java_sdk_path = "${JAVA_HOME}"
          export/android/shutdown_adb_on_exit = true
          EOF

      - name: Verify Play export contract
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          grep -F 'name="Android Play Release"' godot/export_presets.cfg
          grep -F 'gradle_build/use_gradle_build=true' godot/export_presets.cfg
          grep -F 'gradle_build/export_format=1' godot/export_presets.cfg
          grep -F 'gradle_build/target_sdk="36"' godot/export_presets.cfg
          grep -F 'architectures/arm64-v8a=true' godot/export_presets.cfg
          grep -F 'architectures/x86_64=false' godot/export_presets.cfg
          grep -F 'package/unique_name="com.deadlinezero.game"' godot/export_presets.cfg
          grep -F 'package/name="Deadline: Zero"' godot/export_presets.cfg

      - name: Import project
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 \
            --headless --path godot --editor --quit

      - name: Create ephemeral release keystore
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          keytool -genkeypair -v \
            -keystore /tmp/deadline-zero-ci-release.keystore \
            -storepass DeadlineZeroCI \
            -alias deadlinezeroci \
            -keypass DeadlineZeroCI \
            -dname "CN=Deadline Zero CI,O=Deadline Zero,C=FR" \
            -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000

      - name: Export signed arm64 Play AAB
        env:
          GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_RELEASE_PATH: /tmp/deadline-zero-ci-release.keystore
          GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_RELEASE_USER: deadlinezeroci
          GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_RELEASE_PASSWORD: DeadlineZeroCI
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/godot-play
          /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 \
            --headless --path godot \
            --install-android-build-template \
            --export-release "Android Play Release" \
            "$(pwd)/build/godot-play/deadline-zero-play-release.aab"
          test -s build/godot-play/deadline-zero-play-release.aab
          test -f godot/android/build/build.gradle

      - name: Validate AAB package, signature and native ABI
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          AAB=build/godot-play/deadline-zero-play-release.aab
          unzip -l "$AAB" | tee build/godot-play/aab-contents.txt
          grep -q 'base/lib/arm64-v8a/' build/godot-play/aab-contents.txt
          ! grep -q 'base/lib/x86_64/' build/godot-play/aab-contents.txt
          ! grep -q 'base/lib/armeabi-v7a/' build/godot-play/aab-contents.txt
          unzip -p "$AAB" base/manifest/AndroidManifest.xml | strings > build/godot-play/manifest-strings.txt
          grep -q 'com.deadlinezero.game' build/godot-play/manifest-strings.txt
          jarsigner -verify "$AAB" | tee build/godot-play/jarsigner-verify.txt
          grep -q 'jar verified' build/godot-play/jarsigner-verify.txt
          (cd build/godot-play && sha256sum deadline-zero-play-release.aab > SHA256SUMS.txt)
          (cd build/godot-play && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt)

      - name: Upload Play AAB verification evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deadline-zero-play-aab-verify-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            build/godot-play/deadline-zero-play-release.aab
            build/godot-play/aab-contents.txt
            build/godot-play/manifest-strings.txt
            build/godot-play/jarsigner-verify.txt
            build/godot-play/SHA256SUMS.txt
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
````

## File: .github/workflows/godot-play-screenshots.yml
````yaml
name: Godot Play Screenshots

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'godot/**'
      - 'tools/audio/**'
      - '.github/workflows/godot-play-screenshots.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  capture:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Generate original authored audio
        run: python3 tools/audio/generate_deadline_zero_audio.py

      - name: Download Godot 4.7.2
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fL --retry 4 https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip -o /tmp/godot.zip
          unzip -q /tmp/godot.zip -d /tmp/godot
          chmod +x /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64

      - name: Import project and install software render dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 --headless --path godot --editor --quit
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y xvfb libgl1-mesa-dri

      - name: Capture 1920x1080 gameplay candidates
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/play-store-candidates

          capture() {
            script="$1"
            source_png="$2"
            target_png="$3"
            rm -f "$source_png"
            timeout 150s env LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 xvfb-run -a --server-args="-screen 0 1920x1080x24" \
              /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 \
              --path godot \
              --resolution 1920x1080 \
              --rendering-method gl_compatibility \
              --audio-driver Dummy \
              --script "$script"
            test -s "$source_png"
            cp "$source_png" "build/play-store-candidates/$target_png"
          }

          capture res://tests/rendered_frame_smoke_test.gd /tmp/deadline-zero-rendered-frame.png 01-first-playable.png
          capture res://tests/pressure_frame_render_test.gd /tmp/deadline-zero-pressure-frame.png 02-midrun-pressure.png
          capture res://tests/boss_encounter_render_test.gd /tmp/deadline-zero-boss-encounter.png 03-boss-encounter.png
          capture res://tests/upgrade_choice_render_test.gd /tmp/deadline-zero-upgrade-choice.png 04-upgrade-choice.png
          capture res://tests/game_over_render_test.gd /tmp/deadline-zero-game-over-frame.png 05-run-end.png

      - name: Validate Play screenshot dimensions
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import struct
          from pathlib import Path

          shots = sorted(Path("build/play-store-candidates").glob("*.png"))
          assert len(shots) == 5, f"expected 5 screenshots, got {len(shots)}"
          for path in shots:
              data = path.read_bytes()
              assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", f"{path} is not PNG"
              width, height = struct.unpack(">II", data[16:24])
              color_type = data[25]
              assert (width, height) == (1920, 1080), f"{path} is {width}x{height}, expected 1920x1080"
              assert color_type == 2, f"{path} must be opaque RGB PNG (color type 2), got {color_type}"
              print(f"PLAY_SCREENSHOT_OK {path.name} {width}x{height} rgb=1 bytes={len(data)}")
          PY

      - name: Upload Play screenshot candidates
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deadline-zero-play-screenshot-candidates-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/play-store-candidates/*.png
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Render authored Play branding candidates
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/play-branding-candidates
          timeout 150s env LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 xvfb-run -a --server-args="-screen 0 1280x720x24" \
            /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 \
            --path godot \
            --rendering-method gl_compatibility \
            --audio-driver Dummy \
            --script res://tests/play_icon_render_test.gd
          timeout 150s env LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 xvfb-run -a --server-args="-screen 0 1280x720x24" \
            /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 \
            --path godot \
            --rendering-method gl_compatibility \
            --audio-driver Dummy \
            --script res://tests/play_feature_graphic_render_test.gd
          cp /tmp/deadline-zero-play-icon-candidate.png build/play-branding-candidates/icon-candidate.png
          cp /tmp/deadline-zero-feature-graphic-candidate.png build/play-branding-candidates/feature-graphic-candidate.png

      - name: Validate branding candidate dimensions
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import struct
          from pathlib import Path
          expected = {
              "icon-candidate.png": (512, 512),
              "feature-graphic-candidate.png": (1024, 500),
          }
          for name, dims in expected.items():
              path = Path("build/play-branding-candidates") / name
              data = path.read_bytes()
              assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", f"{path} is not PNG"
              width, height = struct.unpack(">II", data[16:24])
              color_type = data[25]
              assert (width, height) == dims, f"{path} is {width}x{height}, expected {dims[0]}x{dims[1]}"
              if name == "feature-graphic-candidate.png":
                  assert color_type == 2, f"{path} must be opaque RGB PNG (color type 2), got {color_type}"
              else:
                  assert color_type in (2, 6), f"{path} has unsupported PNG color type {color_type}"
              print(f"PLAY_BRANDING_CANDIDATE_OK {name} {width}x{height} color_type={color_type} bytes={len(data)}")
          PY

      - name: Upload Play branding candidates
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deadline-zero-play-branding-candidates-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/play-branding-candidates/*.png
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Promote validated Play Store assets
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p play/store/phone-screenshots
          cp build/play-branding-candidates/icon-candidate.png play/store/icon.png
          cp build/play-branding-candidates/feature-graphic-candidate.png play/store/feature-graphic.png
          rm -f play/store/phone-screenshots/*.png
          cp build/play-store-candidates/*.png play/store/phone-screenshots/

          python3 - <<'PY'
          import struct
          from pathlib import Path

          expected = {
              Path("play/store/icon.png"): (512, 512),
              Path("play/store/feature-graphic.png"): (1024, 500),
          }
          for path, dims in expected.items():
              data = path.read_bytes()
              assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", f"{path} is not PNG"
              width, height = struct.unpack(">II", data[16:24])
              color_type = data[25]
              assert (width, height) == dims, f"{path} has unexpected dimensions {width}x{height}"
              if path.name == "feature-graphic.png":
                  assert color_type == 2, f"{path} must be opaque RGB PNG, got color type {color_type}"

          shots = sorted(Path("play/store/phone-screenshots").glob("*.png"))
          assert len(shots) == 5, f"expected 5 promoted screenshots, got {len(shots)}"
          for path in shots:
              data = path.read_bytes()
              width, height = struct.unpack(">II", data[16:24])
              color_type = data[25]
              assert (width, height) == (1920, 1080), f"{path} is {width}x{height}"
              assert color_type == 2, f"{path} must be opaque RGB PNG, got color type {color_type}"
          PY

          git config user.name "deadline-zero-ci"
          git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add play/store/icon.png play/store/feature-graphic.png play/store/phone-screenshots

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Validated Store assets already match the generated runtime captures."
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "chore(store): promote validated Godot listing assets [skip render]"
          git fetch origin main

          changed_since_capture="$(git diff --name-only "${GITHUB_SHA}"..origin/main || true)"
          unsafe_changes="$(printf '%s\n' "$changed_since_capture" | grep -Ev '^(\.ai/|docs/|play/store/.*\.md$|godot/PLAY_RELEASE\.md$|\.github/workflows/godot-play-signed-release\.yml$|$)' || true)"
          if [ -n "$unsafe_changes" ]; then
            echo "Main advanced with runtime/store-relevant changes; refusing stale asset promotion:"
            printf '%s\n' "$unsafe_changes"
            exit 0
          fi

          if [ "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" != "${GITHUB_SHA}" ]; then
            git rebase origin/main
          fi
          git push origin HEAD:main
````

## File: .github/workflows/godot-play-signed-release.yml
````yaml
name: Godot Play Signed Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version_code:
        description: "Google Play version code (must be newer than every prior upload)"
        required: true
        type: number
      version_name:
        description: "User-visible release version, e.g. 0.1.0"
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: godot-play-signed-release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build-signed-aab:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      VERSION_CODE: ${{ inputs.version_code }}
      VERSION_NAME: ${{ inputs.version_name }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Require protected production signing secrets
        env:
          KEYSTORE_B64: ${{ secrets.PLAY_UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.PLAY_UPLOAD_KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PLAY_UPLOAD_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$KEYSTORE_B64"
          test -n "$KEY_ALIAS"
          test -n "$KEY_PASSWORD"

      - name: Generate original authored audio
        run: python3 tools/audio/generate_deadline_zero_audio.py

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: platform-tools

      - name: Install Android 16 release toolchain
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sdkmanager             "platform-tools"             "platforms;android-36"             "build-tools;35.0.1"             "cmdline-tools;latest"             "cmake;3.10.2.4988404"             "ndk;28.1.13356709"

      - name: Download Godot 4.7.2 and export templates
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fL --retry 4             https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip             -o /tmp/godot.zip
          curl -fL --retry 4             https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_export_templates.tpz             -o /tmp/godot-templates.tpz
          unzip -q /tmp/godot.zip -d /tmp/godot
          chmod +x /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64
          rm -rf /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          mkdir -p /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          unzip -q /tmp/godot-templates.tpz -d /tmp/godot-template-unpack
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable"
          cp -R /tmp/godot-template-unpack/templates/. "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable/"

      - name: Configure Godot Android SDK paths
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/godot"
          cat > "$HOME/.config/godot/editor_settings-4.7.tres" <<EOF
          [gd_resource type="EditorSettings" format=3]

          [resource]
          export/android/android_sdk_path = "${ANDROID_HOME}"
          export/android/java_sdk_path = "${JAVA_HOME}"
          export/android/shutdown_adb_on_exit = true
          EOF

      - name: Apply requested release version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, re
          from pathlib import Path

          path = Path("godot/export_presets.cfg")
          text = path.read_text()
          marker = '[preset.1.options]'
          if marker not in text:
              raise SystemExit("Android Play Release preset options are missing")
          before, play = text.split(marker, 1)
          play, n_code = re.subn(r'version/code=\d+', f'version/code={int(os.environ["VERSION_CODE"])}', play, count=1)
          play, n_name = re.subn(r'version/name="[^"]+"', f'version/name="{os.environ["VERSION_NAME"]}"', play, count=1)
          if n_code != 1 or n_name != 1:
              raise SystemExit("Unable to patch Play version exactly once")
          path.write_text(before + marker + play)
          PY
          grep -F "version/code=${VERSION_CODE}" godot/export_presets.cfg
          grep -F "version/name=\"${VERSION_NAME}\"" godot/export_presets.cfg

      - name: Materialize protected upload keystore
        env:
          KEYSTORE_B64: ${{ secrets.PLAY_UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf '%s' "$KEYSTORE_B64" | base64 --decode > /tmp/deadline-zero-play-upload.keystore
          test -s /tmp/deadline-zero-play-upload.keystore
          chmod 600 /tmp/deadline-zero-play-upload.keystore

      - name: Import project
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64             --headless --path godot --editor --quit

      - name: Export production-signed Play AAB
        env:
          GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_RELEASE_PATH: /tmp/deadline-zero-play-upload.keystore
          GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_RELEASE_USER: ${{ secrets.PLAY_UPLOAD_KEY_ALIAS }}
          GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_RELEASE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PLAY_UPLOAD_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/godot-play-release
          AAB="build/godot-play-release/deadline-zero-${VERSION_NAME}-${VERSION_CODE}.aab"
          /tmp/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64             --headless --path godot             --install-android-build-template             --export-release "Android Play Release"             "$(pwd)/$AAB"
          test -s "$AAB"

      - name: Validate production AAB identity and signing
        env:
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.PLAY_UPLOAD_KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PLAY_UPLOAD_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          AAB="build/godot-play-release/deadline-zero-${VERSION_NAME}-${VERSION_CODE}.aab"
          unzip -l "$AAB" | tee build/godot-play-release/aab-contents.txt
          grep -q 'base/lib/arm64-v8a/' build/godot-play-release/aab-contents.txt
          ! grep -q 'base/lib/x86_64/' build/godot-play-release/aab-contents.txt
          ! grep -q 'base/lib/armeabi-v7a/' build/godot-play-release/aab-contents.txt
          unzip -p "$AAB" base/manifest/AndroidManifest.xml | strings > build/godot-play-release/manifest-strings.txt
          grep -q 'com.deadlinezero.game' build/godot-play-release/manifest-strings.txt
          jarsigner -verify "$AAB" | tee build/godot-play-release/jarsigner-verify.txt
          grep -q 'jar verified' build/godot-play-release/jarsigner-verify.txt
          keytool -list -v             -keystore /tmp/deadline-zero-play-upload.keystore             -storepass "$KEY_PASSWORD"             -alias "$KEY_ALIAS"             > build/godot-play-release/upload-certificate.txt
          (cd build/godot-play-release && sha256sum *.aab > SHA256SUMS.txt)
          (cd build/godot-play-release && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt)

      - name: Upload signed release evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deadline-zero-signed-play-aab-${{ inputs.version_name }}-${{ inputs.version_code }}
          path: |
            build/godot-play-release/*.aab
            build/godot-play-release/aab-contents.txt
            build/godot-play-release/manifest-strings.txt
            build/godot-play-release/jarsigner-verify.txt
            build/godot-play-release/upload-certificate.txt
            build/godot-play-release/SHA256SUMS.txt
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
````

````yaml
          test -s /tmp/deadline-zero-game-over-frame.png
          cp /tmp/deadline-zero-game-over-frame.png build/godot-visual-smoke/run-end-rendered.png

      - name: Upload rendered Godot visual evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: godot-rendered-visual-qa-${{ github.sha }}
````

````yaml
name: Integrate Environment Candidates

on:

        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          fetch-depth: 0

        run: |

          from pathlib import Path

          for biome in biomes:
              p=Path('art_sources/environment')/biome/'candidate-manifest.json'

              assert d['production_ready'] is False
````

````yaml
          'prop/debris_a','prop/debris_b','prop/wall_a','prop/wall_b','prop/crate_a','prop/beacon_a']
````

## File: .github/workflows/responsive-ui-qa.yml
````yaml
name: Responsive UI QA

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore:
      - '.ai/**'
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  wide-phone-ui:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'
      - name: Enable KVM
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm
      - name: Initialize Android SDK tools
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: platform-tools

      - name: Preinstall emulator SDK dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          yes | sdkmanager --licenses >/dev/null || true
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            sdkmanager --install emulator 'system-images;android-35;default;x86_64' && break
            if [ "$attempt" -eq 3 ]; then exit 1; fi
            rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/emulator" "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/.temp" || true
            sleep $((attempt * 4))
          done

      - name: Capture 1536x691 responsive UI
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 35
          force-avd-creation: false
          arch: x86_64
          profile: pixel_2
          emulator-options: -no-snapshot -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -noaudio -no-boot-anim -camera-back none
          emulator-boot-timeout: 600
          disable-animations: true
          script: |
            set -eu
            adb wait-for-device
            timeout 300s bash -c 'until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r")" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done'
            gradle :android:installDebug :android:installDebugAndroidTest
            adb shell settings put secure immersive_mode_confirmations confirmed || true
            # Pixel 2 is naturally portrait. Force a 691x1536 physical display then rotate once so
            # the app receives the same ~1536x691 landscape aspect that failed on the real phone.
            adb shell wm size 691x1536
            adb shell settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0 || true
            adb shell settings put system user_rotation 1 || true
            sleep 2
            adb shell am force-stop com.deadlinezero.game || true
            timeout 5m adb shell am instrument -w -e deadlinezero.wideProbe true -e class com.deadlinezero.game.android.AndroidResponsiveUiVisualProbeTest#capturesWidePhoneMetaAndCombatScreens com.deadlinezero.game.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner | tee /tmp/responsive-ui-qa.txt
            grep -q 'OK (1 test)' /tmp/responsive-ui-qa.txt
            mkdir -p build/android-responsive-ui-qa
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-home.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-home.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-home.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-survivors.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-survivors.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-survivors.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-arsenal.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-arsenal.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-arsenal.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-gear.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-gear.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-gear.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-missions.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-missions.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-missions.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-shop.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-shop.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-shop.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-cloud-save.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-cloud-save.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-cloud-save.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-settings.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-settings.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-settings.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-contract.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-contract.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-contract.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-combat.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-combat.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-combat.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-run-result.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-run-result.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-run-result.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/responsive-1536x691-victory.png build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-victory.png
            test -s build/android-responsive-ui-qa/responsive-1536x691-victory.png
            adb shell wm size reset || true
      - name: Upload responsive UI visual QA
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: android-responsive-ui-qa-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: build/android-responsive-ui-qa/
````

## File: .github/workflows/rex-android-acceptance.yml
````yaml
name: Rex Android Acceptance

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/rex-android-acceptance.yml'
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Rex Animation Smoke"]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      animation_run_id:
        description: "Successful Rex Animation Smoke run ID (defaults to latest successful)"
        required: false
        default: ""

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: rex-android-acceptance
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  android-visual:
    if: >-
      ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
          github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Checkout current main
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main

      - name: Resolve validated Rex smoke
        id: source
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          EVENT_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id || '' }}
          EVENT_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}
          INPUT_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.inputs.animation_run_id || '' }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          run_id=""
          head_sha=""
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_run" ]; then
            run_id="$EVENT_RUN_ID"
            head_sha="$EVENT_HEAD_SHA"
          else
            run_id="$INPUT_RUN_ID"
          fi

          if [ -z "$run_id" ]; then
            response="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location               -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN"               -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json"               "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs?branch=main&status=success&per_page=100")"
            read -r run_id head_sha < <(printf '%s' "$response" | python3 -c '
          import json,sys
          runs=[r for r in json.load(sys.stdin).get("workflow_runs",[]) if r.get("name")=="Rex Animation Smoke"]
          if not runs: raise SystemExit("No successful Rex Animation Smoke run found on main")
          print(runs[0]["id"], runs[0]["head_sha"])
          ')
          fi

          if [ -z "$head_sha" ]; then
            response="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location               -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN"               -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json"               "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$run_id")"
            head_sha="$(printf '%s' "$response" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["head_sha"])')"
          fi

          test -n "$run_id" -a -n "$head_sha"
          echo "run_id=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "head_sha=$head_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Candidate smoke: run=$run_id sha=$head_sha"

      - name: Download validated Rex candidate
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          run-id: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          path: rex-artifact

      - name: Install candidate atlas tooling
        run: python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'Pillow>=10,<12'

      - name: Stage exact smoke candidate into temporary runtime atlas
        shell: bash
        env:
          SOURCE_RUN_ID: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
          SOURCE_HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.source.outputs.head_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$(find rex-artifact -type d -name normalized96 -print -quit)"
          manifest="$(find rex-artifact -type f -name render-manifest.json -print -quit)"
          qa="$(find rex-artifact -type f -name sprite-qa-report.json -print -quit)"
          sheet="$(find rex-artifact -type f -name rex.png -print -quit)"
          test -n "$root" -a -n "$manifest" -a -n "$qa" -a -n "$sheet"

          python3 - "$manifest" "$qa" "$sheet" <<'PY'
          import json,sys
          from PIL import Image

          manifest=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
          qa=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
          assert manifest.get('actor') == 'rex', manifest
          assert manifest.get('frame_count') == 232, manifest
          assert manifest.get('qa_pass') is True, manifest
          assert manifest.get('weapon_visibility_pass') is True, manifest
          assert manifest.get('production_ready') is False, (
              'Candidate Android QA must not silently relabel Rex smoke art as production-ready',
              manifest,
          )
          assert qa.get('pass') is True and qa.get('frame_count') == 232, qa
          with Image.open(sys.argv[3]) as image:
              assert image.format == 'PNG'
              assert image.size == (2784, 768), image.size
          print('Rex smoke candidate contract PASS')
          PY

          python3 tools/sprites/upsert_directional_actor_atlas.py             --actor rex             --root survivor/rex             --input "$root"             --atlas assets/art/game.atlas             --png assets/art/rex.png             --manifest build/rex-candidate-manifest.json             --source-manifest "$manifest"             --source-run-id "$SOURCE_RUN_ID"

          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          atlas=Path('assets/art/game.atlas').read_text()
          dirs=('n','ne','e','se','s','sw','w','nw')
          anims={'idle':4,'run':8,'attack':6,'hit':3,'death':8}
          for direction in dirs:
              for animation,count in anims.items():
                  got=atlas.count(f'survivor/rex/{direction}/{animation}\n')
                  assert got == count, (direction,animation,got,count)
          assert Path('assets/art/rex.png').is_file()
          print('Temporary Android atlas PASS: exact Rex candidate')
          PY

          mkdir -p build/rex-android-acceptance
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          payload={
              'actor':'rex',
              'stage':'candidate-android-visual-qa',
              'source_smoke_run_id':int(os.environ['SOURCE_RUN_ID']),
              'source_head_sha':os.environ['SOURCE_HEAD_SHA'],
              'production_ready':False,
              'android_visual_probe':'pending',
          }
          Path('build/rex-android-acceptance/acceptance-report.json').write_text(
              json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n'
          )
          PY

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'

      - name: Enable KVM
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm

      - name: Validate exact Rex candidate in Android gameplay
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 35
          arch: x86_64
          profile: pixel_2
          emulator-options: -no-snapshot -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -noaudio -no-boot-anim -camera-back none
          disable-animations: true
          script: |
            gradle :android:installDebug :android:installDebugAndroidTest -PallowTestAds=true -PallowPlaceholderAssets=true
            adb shell settings put secure immersive_mode_confirmations confirmed || true
            adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.deadlinezero.game.android.AndroidGameplayVisualProbeTest#capturesRexGameplayAndAttackFrames com.deadlinezero.game.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner | tee /tmp/rex-acceptance.txt
            grep -q 'OK (1 test)' /tmp/rex-acceptance.txt
            adb shell ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-gameplay.png
            adb shell ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-shambler-crowd.png
            adb shell ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-attack.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-gameplay.png build/rex-android-acceptance/rex-gameplay.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-shambler-crowd.png build/rex-android-acceptance/rex-shambler-crowd.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/rex-attack.png build/rex-android-acceptance/rex-attack.png
            test -s build/rex-android-acceptance/rex-gameplay.png
            test -s build/rex-android-acceptance/rex-shambler-crowd.png
            test -s build/rex-android-acceptance/rex-attack.png

      - name: Finalize Rex candidate acceptance report
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          path=Path('build/rex-android-acceptance/acceptance-report.json')
          data=json.loads(path.read_text())
          data['android_visual_probe']='pass'
          data['evidence']=['rex-gameplay.png','rex-shambler-crowd.png','rex-attack.png']
          path.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
          PY

      - name: Upload Rex candidate Android evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rex-candidate-android-acceptance-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: build/rex-android-acceptance/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
````

````yaml
name: Rex Animation Smoke

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Rex Auto-Rig"]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rig_run_id:
        description: "Successful Rex Auto-Rig run ID"
        required: false
        default: ""
  push:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/rex-animation-smoke.yml"
      - ".github/workflows/rex-android-acceptance.yml"

      - "tools/blender/refine_rex_rifle_attack.py"
      - "tools/blender/render_actor_8dir.py"
      - "tools/blender/repair_rex_weights.py"
      - "tools/blender/style_rex_materials.py"
      - "tools/blender/add_rex_rifle.py"

      - "tools/sprites/normalize_rex_frames.py"
      - "tools/sprites/assemble_actor_sheet.py"
permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
jobs:
  animate:
    if: >-
      ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Deadline Zero
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Resolve source rig run
        id: source
        shell: bash
        env:

          TRIGGER_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id || '' }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail; run_id="$INPUT_RUN_ID"; [ -n "$run_id" ] || run_id="$TRIGGER_RUN_ID"
          if [ -z "$run_id" ]; then response="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/rex-auto-rig.yml/runs?status=success&per_page=1")"; run_id="$(printf '%s' "$response" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin).get("workflow_runs",[]); print(r[0]["id"] if r else "")')"; fi
          test -n "$run_id"; echo "run_id=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Download rig artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          run-id: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          path: rig-artifact
      - name: Locate rigged Rex
        run: rig="$(find rig-artifact -type f -name rex_rigged.glb -print -quit)"; test -n "$rig"; echo "REX_RIG=$rig" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install Blender runtime
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y blender libgl1 libegl1 python3-numpy python3-pil
      - name: Repair Rex skin weights
        run: mkdir -p build/rex-animation && blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/repair_rex_weights.py -- --input "$REX_RIG" --output build/rex-animation/rex_repaired.glb --report build/rex-animation/weight-repair-report.json
      - name: Apply Rex premium palette
        run: blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/style_rex_materials.py -- --input build/rex-animation/rex_repaired.glb --output build/rex-animation/rex_styled.glb
      - name: Attach separate Rex rifle
        run: blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/add_rex_rifle.py -- --input build/rex-animation/rex_styled.glb --output build/rex-animation/rex_armed.glb && test -s build/rex-animation/rex_armed.glb
      - name: Build deterministic Rex actions
        run: blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/build_rex_actions.py -- --input build/rex-animation/rex_armed.glb --output build/rex-animation/rex_animated.blend
      - name: Refine rifle firing attack
        run: blender -b build/rex-animation/rex_animated.blend --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/refine_rex_rifle_attack.py -- --output build/rex-animation/rex_animated.blend
      - name: Validate weapon visibility
        run: blender -b build/rex-animation/rex_animated.blend --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/validate_rex_weapon_visibility.py -- --report build/rex-animation/weapon-visibility-report.json --size 512
      - name: Render 8-direction masters
        run: blender -b build/rex-animation/rex_animated.blend --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/blender/render_actor_8dir.py -- --actor rex --output build/rex-animation/rendered --size 512 && test "$(find build/rex-animation/rendered -type f -name '*.png' | wc -l)" -eq 232
      - name: Normalize to 96px and run sprite QA
        run: python3 tools/sprites/normalize_rex_frames.py --input build/rex-animation/rendered --output build/rex-animation/normalized96 --report build/rex-animation/sprite-qa-report.json --contact-sheet build/rex-animation/rex-phone-contact-sheet.png
      - name: Assemble canonical Rex source sheet
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/sprites/assemble_actor_sheet.py \
            --input build/rex-animation/normalized96 \
            --output build/rex-animation/rex.png \
            --manifest build/rex-animation/rex-sheet-manifest.json
          cp build/rex-animation/rex.png art_sources/rex.png
          python3 tools/validate_rex_reference.py
          python3 tools/validate_final_sprite_layout.py
          python3 tools/build_final_sprite_frames.py \
            --output build/rex-animation/roundtrip \
            --clean \
            --strict
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          from PIL import Image, ImageChops

          source = Path("build/rex-animation/normalized96")
          rebuilt = Path("build/rex-animation/roundtrip/survivor/rex")
          motions = {"idle": 4, "run": 8, "attack": 6, "hit": 3, "death": 8}
          directions = ("n", "ne", "e", "se", "s", "sw", "w", "nw")

          checked = 0
          for direction in directions:
              for motion, count in motions.items():
                  for index in range(count):
                      before = source / motion / direction / f"{motion}_{index:02d}.png"
                      after = rebuilt / direction / f"{motion}_{index:02d}.png"
                      assert after.is_file(), after
                      with Image.open(before) as a, Image.open(after) as b:
                          a_rgba = a.convert("RGBA")
                          b_rgba = b.convert("RGBA")
                          assert a_rgba.size == b_rgba.size, (before, after)
                          assert ImageChops.difference(a_rgba, b_rgba).getbbox() is None, (before, after)
                      checked += 1
          assert checked == 232
          print(f"Rex canonical sheet round-trip PASS: {checked} pixel-identical frames")
          PY
          rm art_sources/rex.png

      - name: Build render manifest
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,json
          from pathlib import Path
          root=Path('build/rex-animation/normalized96'); files=sorted(root.rglob('*.png')); qa=json.loads(Path('build/rex-animation/sprite-qa-report.json').read_text()); weapon=json.loads(Path('build/rex-animation/weapon-visibility-report.json').read_text())
          p={'actor':'rex','stage':'armed-styled-phone-scale-animation-smoke','production_ready':False,'frame_count':len(files),'expected_frame_count':232,'render_size':[96,96],'qa_pass':qa['pass'],'weapon_visibility_pass':weapon['pass'],'palette':'navy-black-cyan-orange','weapon':'separate-procedural-rifle-v2','attack_motion':'rifle-fire-v2','files':[{'path':str(f.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for f in files]}
          Path('build/rex-animation/render-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(p,indent=2)+'\n'); assert len(files)==232 and qa['pass'] and weapon['pass']
          PY
      - name: Upload animation smoke artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rex-animation-smoke-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/rex-animation/rex_armed.glb
            build/rex-animation/rex_animated.blend
            build/rex-animation/weight-repair-report.json
            build/rex-animation/weapon-visibility-report.json
            build/rex-animation/sprite-qa-report.json
            build/rex-animation/render-manifest.json
            build/rex-animation/rex-phone-contact-sheet.png
            build/rex-animation/rex.png
            build/rex-animation/rex-sheet-manifest.json
            build/rex-animation/roundtrip/final-sprite-build.json
            build/rex-animation/normalized96/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
````
