## File: .github/workflows/rex-auto-rig.yml
````yaml
name: Rex Auto-Rig

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source_path:
        description: "Path to Rex GLB in repository"
        required: false
        default: "art_sources/rex/master/rex_source.glb"
      source_url:
        description: "Optional HTTPS URL used when source_path is absent"
        required: false
        default: ""
  push:
    paths:
      - "art_sources/rex/master/rex_source.glb"
      - "art_sources/rex/master/source-url.txt"
      - "art_sources/rex/master/proxy_parts/**"
      - "art_sources/rex/master/proxy-manifest.json"
      - ".github/workflows/rex-auto-rig.yml"
      - "tools/blender/validate_rig.py"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  rig:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      SOURCE_PATH: ${{ github.event.inputs.source_path || 'art_sources/rex/master/rex_source.glb' }}
      SOURCE_URL_INPUT: ${{ github.event.inputs.source_url || '' }}
      HD_SHA256: 43c2bffdcbcbacd59327bef34b2a71ef2afbebbe5d032ecfadedbd109f717d17
      PROXY_SHA256: 1672041817d8c85da094436a1b21087adf4f19d12e672f20987fa5a9770695ac
      MOTIUS_COMMIT: 5d98709adcb02c7f668019f96d89be39b90e4c05

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Deadline Zero
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Resolve Rex source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          resolved=""
          expected=""
          kind=""

          if [ -s "$SOURCE_PATH" ]; then
            resolved="$SOURCE_PATH"
            expected="$HD_SHA256"
            kind="hd"
          else
            url="$SOURCE_URL_INPUT"
            if [ -z "$url" ] && [ -s art_sources/rex/master/source-url.txt ]; then
              url="$(tr -d '\r\n' < art_sources/rex/master/source-url.txt)"
            fi

            if [ -n "$url" ]; then
              case "$url" in
                https://*) ;;
                *) echo "::error::Rex source URL must use HTTPS"; exit 2 ;;
              esac
              mkdir -p build/rex-source
              resolved="build/rex-source/rex_source.glb"
              curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --max-time 180 \
                --output "$resolved" "$url"
              expected="$HD_SHA256"
              kind="hd-url"
            elif compgen -G 'art_sources/rex/master/proxy_parts/part*.b64' > /dev/null; then
              mkdir -p build/rex-source
              cat art_sources/rex/master/proxy_parts/part*.b64 > build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb.xz.b64
              base64 --decode build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb.xz.b64 > build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb.xz
              xz --decompress --stdout build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb.xz > build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb
              resolved="build/rex-source/rex_proxy.glb"
              expected="$PROXY_SHA256"
              kind="proxy"
            else
              echo "::error::No Rex HD source, URL, or embedded proxy is available"
              exit 2
            fi
          fi

          test -s "$resolved"
          actual="$(sha256sum "$resolved" | awk '{print $1}')"
          if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then
            echo "::error::Rex source SHA-256 mismatch: expected $expected, got $actual"
            exit 3
          fi

          echo "REX_SOURCE=$resolved" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "REX_SOURCE_KIND=$kind" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          sha256sum "$resolved" | tee rex-source.sha256
          file "$resolved"
          echo "Resolved Rex source kind: $kind"

      - name: Install Blender runtime
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y blender libgl1 libegl1 xz-utils python3-numpy
          blender --version | head -n 2
          blender -b --factory-startup --python-expr "import numpy as np; print('Blender NumPy', np.__version__)"

      - name: Fetch pinned Motius template rigger
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git init .motius
          git -C .motius remote add origin https://github.com/ZeyuLing/Motius.git
          git -C .motius sparse-checkout init --cone
          git -C .motius sparse-checkout set motius/motion/rigging
          git -C .motius fetch --depth 1 origin "$MOTIUS_COMMIT"
          git -C .motius checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
          test -s .motius/motius/motion/rigging/_blender.py
          test -s .motius/motius/motion/rigging/template.py

      - name: Auto-rig Rex with deterministic Motius template
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/rex-autorig
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          root = Path.cwd()
          output = (root / "build/rex-autorig/rex_rigged.glb").resolve()
          manifest = Path(f"{output}.json")
          job = {
              "schema_version": 1,
              "method": "template",
              "character_path": str((root / os.environ["REX_SOURCE"]).resolve()),
              "output_path": str(output),
              "manifest_path": str(manifest),
              "template_module": str((root / ".motius/motius/motion/rigging/template.py").resolve()),
              "up_axis": "auto",
              "replace_existing_rig": False,
              "weight_method": "capsules",
              "config": {
                  "top_k": 4,
                  "weight_falloff": 1.75,
                  "side_penalty": 0.025,
                  "chunk_size": 16384,
              },
          }
          Path("build/rex-autorig/template-job.json").write_text(
              json.dumps(job, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
          )
          PY

          blender --background --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 \
            --python .motius/motius/motion/rigging/_blender.py -- \
            --job build/rex-autorig/template-job.json

          test -s build/rex-autorig/rex_rigged.glb
          test -s build/rex-autorig/rex_rigged.glb.json
          sha256sum build/rex-autorig/rex_rigged.glb | tee build/rex-autorig/rex-rigged.sha256

      - name: Validate rig and render previews
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          blender -b --python tools/blender/validate_rig.py -- \
            --input build/rex-autorig/rex_rigged.glb \
            --output build/rex-autorig/validation

      - name: Add report to job summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "## Rex auto-rig" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "Source kind: ${REX_SOURCE_KIND:-unresolved}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "Method: template (Motius $MOTIUS_COMMIT)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if [ -f rex-source.sha256 ]; then
            echo '```text' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            cat rex-source.sha256 >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
          if [ -f build/rex-autorig/validation/rig-report.json ]; then
            echo '### Structural validation' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo '```json' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            cat build/rex-autorig/validation/rig-report.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - name: Upload rig artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rex-auto-rig-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            rex-source.sha256
            build/rex-source/
            build/rex-autorig/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
````

## File: .github/workflows/rex-publish-current.yml
````yaml
name: Publish Validated Rex

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      animation_run_id:
        description: "Successful Rex Animation Smoke run ID (defaults to latest successful)"
        required: false
        default: ""
permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: write

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Deadline Zero
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Resolve validated animation run
        id: source
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.inputs.animation_run_id || '' }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          run_id="$INPUT_RUN_ID"
          if [ -z "$run_id" ]; then
            response="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/rex-animation-smoke.yml/runs?status=success&per_page=1")"
            run_id="$(printf '%s' "$response" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin).get("workflow_runs",[]); print(r[0]["id"] if r else "")')"
          fi
          test -n "$run_id"
          echo "run_id=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Download validated Rex artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          run-id: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          path: rex-artifact

      - name: Install atlas tooling
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3-pil

      - name: Locate and verify sprite source
        id: sprites
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$(find rex-artifact -type d -name normalized96 -print -quit)"
          sheet="$(find rex-artifact -type f -name rex.png -print -quit)"
          manifest="$(find rex-artifact -type f -name render-manifest.json -print -quit)"
          qa="$(find rex-artifact -type f -name sprite-qa-report.json -print -quit)"
          test -n "$root" -a -n "$sheet" -a -n "$manifest" -a -n "$qa"
          python3 - "$manifest" "$qa" "$sheet" <<'PY'
          import json,sys
          from PIL import Image
          manifest=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); qa=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
          assert manifest.get('frame_count') == 232
          assert manifest.get('qa_pass') is True
          assert manifest.get('weapon_visibility_pass') is True
          assert manifest.get('production_ready') is True, (
              "Refusing to publish Rex as production art: source manifest is not production-approved"
          )
          assert qa.get('pass') is True and qa.get('frame_count') == 232
          with Image.open(sys.argv[3]) as im:
              assert im.format == 'PNG'
              assert im.size == (2784, 768), im.size
              assert im.mode in ('RGBA', 'LA', 'P')
          PY
          echo "root=$root" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "sheet=$sheet" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "manifest=$manifest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Stage canonical Rex production source
        env:
          CANONICAL_SHEET: ${{ steps.sprites.outputs.sheet }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cp "$CANONICAL_SHEET" art_sources/rex.png
          python3 tools/validate_rex_reference.py
          python3 tools/validate_final_sprite_layout.py
          python3 tools/build_final_sprite_frames.py \
            --output build/rex-publish-roundtrip \
            --clean \
            --strict

      - name: Upsert production Rex atlas page
        env:
          SPRITE_ROOT: ${{ steps.sprites.outputs.root }}
          SOURCE_MANIFEST: ${{ steps.sprites.outputs.manifest }}
          SOURCE_RUN_ID: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/sprites/upsert_directional_actor_atlas.py \
            --actor rex \
            --root survivor/rex \
            --input "$SPRITE_ROOT" \
            --atlas assets/art/game.atlas \
            --png assets/art/rex.png \
            --manifest assets/art/rex-manifest.json \
            --source-manifest "$SOURCE_MANIFEST" \
            --source-run-id "$SOURCE_RUN_ID"

      - name: Verify Rex production regions and preserved pages
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          atlas=Path('assets/art/game.atlas').read_text()
          dirs=('n','ne','e','se','s','sw','w','nw')
          anims={'idle':4,'run':8,'attack':6,'hit':3,'death':8}
          for d in dirs:
              for anim,count in anims.items():
                  got=atlas.count(f'survivor/rex/{d}/{anim}\n')
                  assert got == count, (d,anim,got,count)
          assert Path('assets/art/rex.png').is_file()
          print('Rex atlas contract PASS; existing non-Rex pages preserved by upsert publisher')
          PY

      - name: Commit Rex atlas to main
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "deadline-zero-art-bot"
          git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add art_sources/rex.png assets/art/rex.png assets/art/game.atlas assets/art/rex-manifest.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Atlas already current"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "Publish validated Rex production atlas"
          git push origin HEAD:main

name: Shambler Android Acceptance

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'core/src/main/java/com/deadlinezero/game/visual/ArtProfileCatalog.java'
      - 'core/src/main/java/com/deadlinezero/game/visual/CharacterSpriteRenderer.java'
      - 'android/src/androidTest/java/com/deadlinezero/game/android/AndroidGameplayVisualProbeTest.java'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/shambler-android-acceptance.yml'
      - 'core/src/main/java/com/deadlinezero/game/visual/ArtProfileCatalog.java'
      - 'core/src/main/java/com/deadlinezero/game/visual/CharacterSpriteRenderer.java'
      - 'android/src/androidTest/java/com/deadlinezero/game/android/AndroidGameplayVisualProbeTest.java'
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Shambler Animation Smoke"]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      animation_run_id:
        description: "Successful Shambler Animation Smoke run ID (defaults to latest successful)"
        required: false
        default: ""

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: shambler-android-acceptance
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  android-visual:
    if: >-
      ${{ github.event_name == 'push' ||
          github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
          github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Checkout candidate runtime
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.head_ref || github.event_name == 'push' && github.sha || 'main' }}

      - name: Resolve validated Shambler smoke
        id: source
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          EVENT_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id || '' }}
          EVENT_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}
          INPUT_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.inputs.animation_run_id || '' }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          run_id=""
          head_sha=""
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_run" ]; then
            run_id="$EVENT_RUN_ID"
            head_sha="$EVENT_HEAD_SHA"
          else
            run_id="$INPUT_RUN_ID"
          fi

          if [ -z "$run_id" ]; then
            response="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location               -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN"               -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json"               "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs?branch=main&status=success&per_page=100")"
            read -r run_id head_sha < <(printf '%s' "$response" | python3 -c '
          import json,sys
          runs=[r for r in json.load(sys.stdin).get("workflow_runs",[]) if r.get("name")=="Shambler Animation Smoke"]
          if runs:
              print(runs[0]["id"], runs[0]["head_sha"])
          else:
              print("", "")
          ')
          fi

          if [ -z "$run_id" ]; then
            echo "available=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::No successful Shambler Animation Smoke source exists on main; candidate acceptance is not applicable."
            exit 0
          fi

          if [ -z "$head_sha" ]; then
            response="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location               -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN"               -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json"               "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$run_id")"
            head_sha="$(printf '%s' "$response" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["head_sha"])')"
          fi

          test -n "$run_id" -a -n "$head_sha"
          echo "available=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "run_id=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "head_sha=$head_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Candidate smoke: run=$run_id sha=$head_sha"

      - name: Download validated Shambler candidate
        if: steps.source.outputs.available == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          run-id: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          path: shambler-artifact

      - name: Install candidate atlas tooling
        if: steps.source.outputs.available == 'true'
        run: python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'Pillow>=10,<12'

      - name: Stage exact smoke candidate into temporary runtime atlas
        if: steps.source.outputs.available == 'true'
        id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          SOURCE_RUN_ID: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
          SOURCE_HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.source.outputs.head_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$(find shambler-artifact -type d -name normalized96 -print -quit)"
          manifest="$(find shambler-artifact -type f -name render-manifest.json -print -quit)"
          qa="$(find shambler-artifact -type f -name qa.json -print -quit)"
          sheet="$(find shambler-artifact -type f -name shambler.png -print -quit)"
          test -n "$root" -a -n "$manifest" -a -n "$qa" -a -n "$sheet"

          python3 - "$manifest" "$qa" "$sheet" <<'PY'
          import json,sys
          from PIL import Image

          manifest=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
          qa=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
          assert manifest.get('actor') == 'shambler', manifest
          assert manifest.get('frame_count') == 232, manifest
          assert manifest.get('production_ready') is False, (
              'Candidate Android QA must not silently relabel smoke art as production-ready',
              manifest,
          )
          assert qa.get('pass') is True and qa.get('frame_count') == 232, qa
          with Image.open(sys.argv[3]) as image:
              assert image.format == 'PNG'
              assert image.size == (2784, 768), image.size
          print('Shambler smoke candidate contract PASS')
          PY

          python3 tools/sprites/upsert_directional_actor_atlas.py             --actor shambler             --root enemy/shambler             --input "$root"             --atlas assets/art/game.atlas             --png assets/art/shambler.png             --manifest build/shambler-candidate-manifest.json             --source-manifest "$manifest"             --source-run-id "$SOURCE_RUN_ID"

          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          atlas=Path('assets/art/game.atlas').read_text()
          dirs=('n','ne','e','se','s','sw','w','nw')
          anims={'idle':4,'run':8,'attack':6,'hit':3,'death':8}
          for root in ('survivor/rex','enemy/shambler'):
              for direction in dirs:
                  for animation,count in anims.items():
                      got=atlas.count(f'{root}/{direction}/{animation}\n')
                      assert got == count, (root,direction,animation,got,count)
          assert Path('assets/art/shambler.png').is_file()
          print('Temporary Android atlas PASS: Rex + exact Shambler candidate')
          PY

          mkdir -p build/shambler-android-acceptance
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          payload={
              'actor':'shambler',
              'stage':'candidate-android-visual-qa',
              'source_smoke_run_id':int(os.environ['SOURCE_RUN_ID']),
              'source_head_sha':os.environ['SOURCE_HEAD_SHA'],
              'production_ready':False,
              'android_visual_probe':'pending',
          }
          Path('build/shambler-android-acceptance/acceptance-report.json').write_text(
              json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n'
          )
          PY

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        if: steps.source.outputs.available == 'true'
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        if: steps.source.outputs.available == 'true'
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'

      - name: Enable KVM
        if: steps.source.outputs.available == 'true'
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm

      - name: Validate exact Shambler candidate in Android gameplay
        if: steps.source.outputs.available == 'true'
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 35
          arch: x86_64
          profile: pixel_2
          emulator-options: -no-snapshot -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -noaudio -no-boot-anim -camera-back none
          disable-animations: true
          script: |
            gradle :android:installDebug :android:installDebugAndroidTest -PallowTestAds=true -PallowPlaceholderAssets=true
            adb shell settings put secure immersive_mode_confirmations confirmed || true
            adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.deadlinezero.game.android.AndroidGameplayVisualProbeTest#capturesShamblerGameplayAndAttackFrames com.deadlinezero.game.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner | tee /tmp/shambler-acceptance.txt
            grep -q 'OK (1 test)' /tmp/shambler-acceptance.txt
            adb shell ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/shambler-gameplay.png
            adb shell ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/shambler-attack.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/shambler-gameplay.png build/shambler-android-acceptance/shambler-gameplay.png
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/shambler-attack.png build/shambler-android-acceptance/shambler-attack.png
            test -s build/shambler-android-acceptance/shambler-gameplay.png
            test -s build/shambler-android-acceptance/shambler-attack.png

      - name: Finalize Shambler candidate acceptance report
        if: steps.source.outputs.available == 'true'
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          path=Path('build/shambler-android-acceptance/acceptance-report.json')
          data=json.loads(path.read_text())
          data['android_visual_probe']='pass'
          data['evidence']=['shambler-gameplay.png','shambler-attack.png']
          path.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
          PY

      - name: Upload Shambler candidate Android evidence
        if: steps.source.outputs.available == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: shambler-candidate-android-acceptance-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: build/shambler-android-acceptance/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

## File: .github/workflows/shambler-animation-smoke.yml
````yaml
name: Shambler Animation Smoke
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/shambler-animation-smoke.yml'
      - 'tools/blender/render_actor_8dir.py'
      - 'tools/sprites/normalize_actor_frames.py'
      - 'tools/sprites/assemble_actor_sheet.py'

jobs:
  render:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Download locked CC0 Shambler source
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'gdown>=5.2,<6'
          mkdir -p build/shambler-source/Textures
          gdown 'https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1MR_TE1FwriGLRKjJYLvsgJNOtYZDs1mu' -O build/shambler-source/Zombie_Basic.blend
          gdown 'https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1f4CRjRp4V7p7XIRo0X-DXpYc2AoMx7S7' -O build/shambler-source/Zombie_Atlas.png
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import hashlib, shutil
          expected={
            'Zombie_Basic.blend':'d13e073d52255d6a8a43160c6452755358c5a6cbbf900f2526359f113d8ed6ce',
            'Zombie_Atlas.png':'8803e5543d5e6b6f66aa41a5ef93e6c2ffb77b5476d0202296d2f4c8f4eb9e8d',
          }
          root=Path('build/shambler-source')
          for name,want in expected.items():
              got=hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
              print(name, got)
              if got != want: raise SystemExit(f'SHA mismatch for {name}')
          shutil.copy2(root/'Zombie_Atlas.png', root/'Textures'/'Atlas_Zombie.png')
          PY
      - name: Install Blender and image tooling
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y blender libegl1 libgl1-mesa-dri
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'Pillow>=10,<12'
          blender --version | head -n 1
          ldconfig -p | grep -F 'libEGL.so.1'
      - name: Render native Shambler actions into exact contract
        run: |
          # Native Death contains substantial root motion. Render with a wider
          # orthographic field so the master frames preserve the entire fall;
          # the fixed-transform normalizer restores phone-scale occupancy later.
          blender -b build/shambler-source/Zombie_Basic.blend \
            -P tools/blender/render_actor_8dir.py -- \
            --actor shambler \
            --output build/shambler/master512 \
            --target-height 0.58 \
            --ortho-scale 3.25 \
            --idle-action Idle \
            --run-action Walk \
            --attack-action Punch \
            --hit-action HitReact \
            --death-action Death
          test "$(find build/shambler/master512 -name '*.png' | wc -l)" -eq 232
          mkdir -p build/shambler/debug512
          for d in n ne e se s sw w nw; do
            cp "build/shambler/master512/idle/$d/idle_00.png" "build/shambler/debug512/${d}_idle_00.png"
          done
      - name: Validate master render margins
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          from PIL import Image
          import json

          root=Path('build/shambler/master512')
          report=Path('build/shambler/master-margin.json')
          required=4
          frames=sorted(root.rglob('*.png'))
          offenders=[]
          empty=[]
          min_margin=10**9
          for path in frames:
              img=Image.open(path).convert('RGBA')
              bbox=img.getchannel('A').getbbox()
              rel=str(path.relative_to(root))
              if bbox is None:
                  empty.append(rel)
                  continue
              left, top, right, bottom=bbox
              margins={
                  'left':left,
                  'top':top,
                  'right':img.width-right,
                  'bottom':img.height-bottom,
              }
              min_margin=min(min_margin,*margins.values())
              bad={k:v for k,v in margins.items() if v < required}
              if bad:
                  offenders.append({'frame':rel,'bbox':[left,top,right,bottom],'margins':margins,'violations':bad})
          payload={
              'pass':len(frames)==232 and not empty and not offenders,
              'frame_count':len(frames),
              'required_margin_px':required,
              'minimum_observed_margin_px':None if min_margin==10**9 else min_margin,
              'empty_frames':empty,
              'offenders':offenders,
          }
          report.write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n')
          print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in payload.items() if k!='offenders'},indent=2))
          if offenders:
              print('Master clipping offenders (first 20):')
              for item in offenders[:20]: print(item)
          if not payload['pass']:
              raise SystemExit('Master-render margin QA failed')
          PY
      - name: Normalize and validate phone-scale frames
        run: |
          # Center the complete per-direction motion envelope rather than the raw
          # source camera center. This keeps asymmetric native root motion (Death)
          # intact without allowing the 96px output crop to cut it off.
          python3 tools/sprites/normalize_actor_frames.py \
            --actor shambler \
            --input build/shambler/master512 \
            --output build/shambler/normalized96 \
            --report build/shambler/qa.json \
            --contact-sheet build/shambler/shambler-phone-contact-sheet.png \
            --horizontal-anchor union-center \
            --attack-center-limit 12
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          q=json.loads(Path('build/shambler/qa.json').read_text())
          assert q['pass'] is True, q
          assert q['frame_count'] == 232, q
          assert q['horizontal_anchor'] == 'union-center', q
          print('Shambler sprite QA PASS:', q['frame_count'], 'frames, scale', q['scale'])
          PY
      - name: Assemble canonical Shambler source sheet
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/sprites/assemble_actor_sheet.py \
            --input build/shambler/normalized96 \
            --output build/shambler/shambler.png \
            --manifest build/shambler/shambler-sheet-manifest.json
          cp build/shambler/shambler.png art_sources/shambler.png
          python3 tools/validate_final_sprite_layout.py
          python3 tools/build_final_sprite_frames.py \
            --output build/shambler/roundtrip \
            --clean \
            --strict
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          from PIL import Image, ImageChops

          source = Path('build/shambler/normalized96')
          rebuilt = Path('build/shambler/roundtrip/enemy/shambler')
          motions = {'idle':4,'run':8,'attack':6,'hit':3,'death':8}
          directions = ('n','ne','e','se','s','sw','w','nw')
          checked = 0
          for direction in directions:
              for motion, count in motions.items():
                  for index in range(count):
                      before = source / motion / direction / f'{motion}_{index:02d}.png'
                      after = rebuilt / direction / f'{motion}_{index:02d}.png'
                      assert after.is_file(), after
                      with Image.open(before) as a, Image.open(after) as b:
                          ar = a.convert('RGBA')
                          br = b.convert('RGBA')
                          assert ar.size == br.size == (96, 96), (before, after, ar.size, br.size)
                          assert ImageChops.difference(ar, br).getbbox() is None, (before, after)
                      checked += 1
          assert checked == 232
          print(f'Shambler canonical sheet round-trip PASS: {checked} pixel-identical RGBA frames')
          PY
          rm art_sources/shambler.png

      - name: Write render manifest
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json
          manifest={
            'actor':'shambler',
            'source':'Quaternius Zombie Apocalypse Kit / Zombie_Basic.blend',
            'license':'CC0 1.0',
            'source_sha256':'d13e073d52255d6a8a43160c6452755358c5a6cbbf900f2526359f113d8ed6ce',
            'texture_sha256':'8803e5543d5e6b6f66aa41a5ef93e6c2ffb77b5476d0202296d2f4c8f4eb9e8d',
            'frame_count':232,
            'cell':[96,96],
            'source_render':[512,512],
            'ortho_scale':3.25,
            'horizontal_anchor':'union-center',
            'directions':['n','ne','e','se','s','sw','w','nw'],
            'animations':{'idle':4,'run':8,'attack':6,'hit':3,'death':8},
            'action_map':{'idle':'Idle','run':'Walk','attack':'Punch','hit':'HitReact','death':'Death'},
            'production_ready':False,
            'stage':'first-native-animation-vertical-slice-candidate',
          }
          Path('build/shambler/render-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
          PY
      - name: Upload Shambler animation smoke
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: shambler-animation-smoke-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/shambler/normalized96/
            build/shambler/qa.json
            build/shambler/master-margin.json
            build/shambler/shambler-phone-contact-sheet.png
            build/shambler/shambler.png
            build/shambler/shambler-sheet-manifest.json
            build/shambler/roundtrip/final-sprite-build.json
            build/shambler/render-manifest.json
            build/shambler/debug512/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

## File: .github/workflows/shambler-publish-current.yml
````yaml
name: Publish Validated Shambler

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      animation_run_id:
        description: "Successful production-approved Shambler Animation Smoke run ID (defaults to latest successful)"
        required: false
        default: ""

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: publish-shambler-production-art
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Deadline Zero
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Resolve validated animation run
        id: source
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.inputs.animation_run_id || '' }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          run_id="$INPUT_RUN_ID"
          if [ -z "$run_id" ]; then
            response="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/shambler-animation-smoke.yml/runs?status=success&branch=main&per_page=1")"
            run_id="$(printf '%s' "$response" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin).get("workflow_runs",[]); print(r[0]["id"] if r else "")')"
          fi
          test -n "$run_id"
          echo "run_id=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Download validated Shambler artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          run-id: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          path: shambler-artifact

      - name: Install atlas tooling
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3-pil

      - name: Locate and verify production-approved sprite source
        id: sprites
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$(find shambler-artifact -type d -name normalized96 -print -quit)"
          sheet="$(find shambler-artifact -type f -name shambler.png -print -quit)"
          manifest="$(find shambler-artifact -type f -name render-manifest.json -print -quit)"
          qa="$(find shambler-artifact -type f -name qa.json -print -quit)"
          margin="$(find shambler-artifact -type f -name master-margin.json -print -quit)"
          test -n "$root" -a -n "$sheet" -a -n "$manifest" -a -n "$qa" -a -n "$margin"
          python3 - "$manifest" "$qa" "$margin" "$sheet" <<'PY'
          import json,sys
          from PIL import Image
          manifest=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
          qa=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
          margin=json.load(open(sys.argv[3]))
          assert manifest.get('actor') == 'shambler', manifest
          assert manifest.get('frame_count') == 232, manifest
          assert manifest.get('horizontal_anchor') == 'union-center', manifest
          assert manifest.get('production_ready') is True, (
              'Refusing to publish Shambler candidate: render-manifest.json must explicitly set production_ready=true',
              manifest,
          )
          assert qa.get('pass') is True and qa.get('frame_count') == 232, qa
          assert qa.get('horizontal_anchor') == 'union-center', qa
          assert margin.get('pass') is True and margin.get('frame_count') == 232, margin
          with Image.open(sys.argv[4]) as im:
              assert im.format == 'PNG'
              assert im.size == (2784, 768), im.size
          PY
          echo "root=$root" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "sheet=$sheet" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "manifest=$manifest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Stage canonical Shambler production source
        env:
          CANONICAL_SHEET: ${{ steps.sprites.outputs.sheet }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cp "$CANONICAL_SHEET" art_sources/shambler.png
          python3 tools/validate_final_sprite_layout.py
          python3 tools/build_final_sprite_frames.py \
            --output build/shambler-publish-roundtrip \
            --clean \
            --strict

      - name: Upsert production Shambler atlas page
        env:
          SPRITE_ROOT: ${{ steps.sprites.outputs.root }}
          SOURCE_MANIFEST: ${{ steps.sprites.outputs.manifest }}
          SOURCE_RUN_ID: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run_id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/sprites/upsert_directional_actor_atlas.py \
            --actor shambler \
            --root enemy/shambler \
            --input "$SPRITE_ROOT" \
            --atlas assets/art/game.atlas \
            --png assets/art/shambler.png \
            --manifest assets/art/shambler-manifest.json \
            --source-manifest "$SOURCE_MANIFEST" \
            --source-run-id "$SOURCE_RUN_ID"

      - name: Verify multi-actor production atlas
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          atlas=Path('assets/art/game.atlas').read_text()
          dirs=('n','ne','e','se','s','sw','w','nw')
          anims={'idle':4,'run':8,'attack':6,'hit':3,'death':8}
          for root in ('survivor/rex','enemy/shambler'):
              for d in dirs:
                  for anim,count in anims.items():
                      got=atlas.count(f'{root}/{d}/{anim}\n')
                      assert got == count, (root,d,anim,got,count)
          assert Path('assets/art/rex.png').is_file()
          assert Path('assets/art/shambler.png').is_file()
          assert atlas.count('rex.png\n') == 1
          assert atlas.count('shambler.png\n') == 1
          print('Multi-actor atlas PASS: Rex 232 + Shambler 232 directional frames')
          PY

      - name: Set up Java 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Set up Gradle 8.11.1
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'

      - name: Run core regression tests
        run: gradle :core:compileJava :core:test

      - name: Commit Shambler atlas to main
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "deadline-zero-art-bot"
          git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add art_sources/shambler.png assets/art/shambler.png assets/art/game.atlas assets/art/shambler-manifest.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Shambler atlas already current"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "Publish validated Shambler production atlas"
          git push origin HEAD:main
````

name: Shambler Source Scout
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/shambler-source-scout.yml'
      - 'tools/blender/inspect_actor_source.py'

jobs:
  scout:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Verify official CC0 source page
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
          import re
          PAGE='https://quaternius.com/packs/zombieapocalypsekit.html'
          html=urlopen(Request(PAGE, headers={'User-Agent':'deadline-zero-art-source-scout/1.3'}), timeout=30).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
          Path('build').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          folders=list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r"https://drive\.google\.com/drive/folders/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+[^'\" )<]*", html)))
          if not folders:
              raise SystemExit('Official Quaternius page no longer exposes the public source folder')
          Path('build/official-drive-folders.txt').write_text('\n'.join(folders)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
          print('Official source folder:', folders[0])
          PY
      - name: Download focused Shambler master
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'gdown>=5.2,<6'
          mkdir -p build/shambler-source
          gdown 'https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1MR_TE1FwriGLRKjJYLvsgJNOtYZDs1mu' -O build/shambler-source/Zombie_Basic.blend
          gdown 'https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1f4CRjRp4V7p7XIRo0X-DXpYc2AoMx7S7' -O build/shambler-source/Zombie_Atlas.png
          test -s build/shambler-source/Zombie_Basic.blend
          test -s build/shambler-source/Zombie_Atlas.png
      - name: Fingerprint focused source
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import hashlib, json
          root=Path('build/shambler-source')
          rows=[]
          for name in ('Zombie_Basic.blend','Zombie_Atlas.png'):
              p=root/name; data=p.read_bytes()
              rows.append({'name':name,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
          report={
              'source_page':'https://quaternius.com/packs/zombieapocalypsekit.html',
              'source_folder':Path('build/official-drive-folders.txt').read_text().strip(),
              'license':'CC0 1.0',
              'selected_master':'Zombie_Basic.blend',
              'files':rows,
          }
          Path('build/shambler-source-scout.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
          print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
          PY
      - name: Install Blender
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y blender
          blender --version | head -n 1
      - name: Inspect selected actor source
        run: |
          blender -b build/shambler-source/Zombie_Basic.blend \
            -P tools/blender/inspect_actor_source.py -- \
            --json-out build/shambler-source-inspection.json
      - name: Upload focused source audit
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: shambler-source-scout-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/shambler-source-scout.json
            build/shambler-source-inspection.json
            build/official-drive-folders.txt
            build/shambler-source/Zombie_Basic.blend
            build/shambler-source/Zombie_Atlas.png
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

## File: .github/workflows/ultimate-monsters-catalog.yml
````yaml
name: Ultimate Monsters Catalog

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/ultimate-monsters-catalog.yml'
      - 'config/active-actor-candidate.txt'
      - 'config/actor-production-contracts.json'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  catalog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: List official Quaternius Ultimate Monsters folder without downloading
        run: |
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check gdown
          mkdir -p build
          gdown --folder --json 'https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18m4KpzpEzhC9wl7jzr6dUc0N8Jozr79C?usp=sharing' > build/ultimate-monsters-drive-list.json

      - name: Build deterministic source catalog and BOSS shortlist
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path

          entries = json.loads(Path('build/ultimate-monsters-drive-list.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          rows = []
          for entry in entries:
              path = entry.get('path', '')
              suffix = Path(path).suffix.lower()
              rows.append({
                  'path': path,
                  'url': entry.get('url'),
                  'suffix': suffix,
              })
          rows.sort(key=lambda r: r['path'].lower())
          report = {
              'provider': 'Quaternius',
              'pack': 'Ultimate Monsters',
              'license': 'CC0 1.0',
              'official_drive_folder_id': '18m4KpzpEzhC9wl7jzr6dUc0N8Jozr79C',
              'file_count': len(rows),
              'blend_count': sum(r['suffix'] == '.blend' for r in rows),
              'fbx_count': sum(r['suffix'] == '.fbx' for r in rows),
              'gltf_count': sum(r['suffix'] in ('.gltf', '.glb') for r in rows),
              'files': rows,
          }
          Path('build/ultimate-monsters-catalog.json').write_text(
              json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8'
          )

          contracts = json.loads(Path('config/actor-production-contracts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          accepted_masters = {}
          for actor_name, actor in contracts.get('actors', {}).items():
              if actor.get('status') != 'accepted':
                  continue
              source = actor.get('source') or {}
              if source.get('pack') != 'Ultimate Monsters':
                  continue
              master = source.get('master')
              if master:
                  accepted_masters[master.lower()] = actor_name

          boss_weights = {
              'dragon': 100,
              'king': 90,
              'golem': 80,
              'yeti': 70,
              'demon': 60,
              'orc': 30,
          }
          reuse_penalty = 1000
          shortlist = []
          for row in rows:
              if row['suffix'] not in ('.blend', '.fbx', '.gltf', '.glb'):
                  continue
              low = row['path'].lower()
              matched = [token for token in boss_weights if token in low]
              if not matched:
                  continue
              reused_by = accepted_masters.get(low)
              base_score = max(boss_weights[token] for token in matched)
              shortlist.append({
                  **row,
                  'boss_score': base_score - (reuse_penalty if reused_by else 0),
                  'base_boss_score': base_score,
                  'matched_tokens': matched,
                  'reuses_accepted_master': bool(reused_by),
                  'reused_by_actor': reused_by,
              })
          shortlist.sort(key=lambda r: (-r['boss_score'], r['path'].lower()))
          novel_count = sum(not row['reuses_accepted_master'] for row in shortlist)
          boss_report = {
              'provider': report['provider'],
              'pack': report['pack'],
              'license': report['license'],
              'selection_goal': 'BOSS source candidates only; prefer a novel master and require immutable fingerprinting, native-action inspection, role metrics, phone-scale review and Android acceptance.',
              'accepted_ultimate_monsters_masters': accepted_masters,
              'reuse_penalty': reuse_penalty,
              'candidate_count': len(shortlist),
              'novel_candidate_count': novel_count,
              'candidates': shortlist,
          }
          Path('build/ultimate-monsters-boss-shortlist.json').write_text(
              json.dumps(boss_report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8'
          )

          print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ('file_count','blend_count','fbx_count','gltf_count')}, indent=2))
          print(f'accepted Ultimate Monsters masters: {len(accepted_masters)}')
          print(f'novel BOSS candidates: {novel_count}/{len(shortlist)}')
          print('--- deterministic BOSS shortlist ---')
          for row in shortlist:
              reuse = f" REUSED_BY={row['reused_by_actor']}" if row['reused_by_actor'] else ''
              print(f"score={row['boss_score']:4d} base={row['base_boss_score']:3d} {row['path']} {row['url']}{reuse}")
          PY

      - name: Verify BOSS shortlist schema
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          data = json.loads(Path('build/ultimate-monsters-boss-shortlist.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          assert data['provider'] == 'Quaternius'
          assert data['pack'] == 'Ultimate Monsters'
          assert data['license'] == 'CC0 1.0'
          assert isinstance(data['candidate_count'], int)
          assert data['candidate_count'] == len(data['candidates'])
          assert isinstance(data['novel_candidate_count'], int)
          assert data['novel_candidate_count'] == sum(not c['reuses_accepted_master'] for c in data['candidates'])
          assert data['novel_candidate_count'] > 0, 'BOSS shortlist contains no novel source master'
          previous = None
          seen_paths = set()
          for candidate in data['candidates']:
              assert candidate['suffix'] in ('.blend', '.fbx', '.gltf', '.glb')
              assert candidate['url']
              assert candidate['matched_tokens']
              assert isinstance(candidate['base_boss_score'], int) and candidate['base_boss_score'] > 0
              assert isinstance(candidate['boss_score'], int)
              assert isinstance(candidate['reuses_accepted_master'], bool)
              if candidate['reuses_accepted_master']:
                  assert candidate['reused_by_actor']
                  assert candidate['boss_score'] < candidate['base_boss_score']
              else:
                  assert candidate['reused_by_actor'] is None
                  assert candidate['boss_score'] == candidate['base_boss_score']
              assert candidate['path'].lower() not in seen_paths
              seen_paths.add(candidate['path'].lower())
              ordering = (-candidate['boss_score'], candidate['path'].lower())
              if previous is not None:
                  assert previous <= ordering
              previous = ordering
          assert not data['candidates'][0]['reuses_accepted_master'], 'Top BOSS candidate must be a novel master'
          print(f"validated {data['candidate_count']} BOSS source candidates ({data['novel_candidate_count']} novel)")
          PY

      - name: Upload official source catalog
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ultimate-monsters-catalog-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/ultimate-monsters-drive-list.json
            build/ultimate-monsters-catalog.json
            build/ultimate-monsters-boss-shortlist.json
          retention-days: 14
````

````yaml
name: Verify
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore:
      - '.ai/**'
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  core:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'
      - name: Validate final sprite production layout
        run: |
          python3 -m py_compile tools/validate_final_sprite_layout.py tools/validate_rex_reference.py tools/slice_sprite_sheet.py tools/build_final_sprite_frames.py tools/verify_final_atlas.py tools/test_verify_final_atlas.py tools/sprites/assemble_actor_sheet.py tools/sprites/audit_final_art_status.py tools/sprites/validate_final_art_promotion_consistency.py tools/sprites/validate_actor_production_contracts.py tools/sprites/resolve_actor_actions.py tools/sprites/test_resolve_actor_actions.py tools/sprites/validate_actor_role_metrics.py tools/sprites/test_validate_actor_role_metrics.py tools/sprites/test_validate_actor_production_contracts.py tools/android/scan_runtime_log.py tools/android/test_scan_runtime_log.py tools/android/build_runtime_release_evidence.py tools/android/test_build_runtime_release_evidence.py tools/environment/validate_environment_art_contract.py tools/environment/test_validate_environment_art_contract.py tools/environment/pack_environment_art.py tools/environment/upsert_environment_atlas.py tools/environment/test_upsert_environment_atlas.py
          python3 tools/validate_final_sprite_layout.py
          python3 tools/validate_rex_reference.py
          mkdir -p build
          python3 tools/sprites/audit_final_art_status.py --json > build/final-art-status.json
          python3 tools/sprites/validate_final_art_promotion_consistency.py
          python3 tools/sprites/validate_actor_production_contracts.py
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_verify_final_atlas.py'
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/sprites -p 'test_resolve_actor_actions.py'
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/sprites -p 'test_validate_actor_role_metrics.py'
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/sprites -p 'test_validate_actor_production_contracts.py'
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/perf -p 'test_compare_android_benchmark.py'
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/android -p 'test_scan_runtime_log.py'
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/android -p 'test_build_runtime_release_evidence.py'
          PYTHONPATH=tools/environment python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/environment -p 'test_validate_environment_art_contract.py'
          PYTHONPATH=tools/environment python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/environment -p 'test_upsert_environment_atlas.py'
          python3 tools/environment/validate_environment_art_contract.py
      - name: Compile and test core
        run: gradle :core:compileJava :core:test :desktop:compileJava
      - name: Smoke-test desktop runtime
        run: xvfb-run -a gradle :desktop:smokeRun

  android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: platform-tools
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'
      - name: Install Android SDK 36
        run: sdkmanager 'platforms;android-36' 'build-tools;36.0.0'
      - name: Verify Android production build
        run: gradle :android:lintDebug :android:lintRelease :android:assembleDebug :android:bundleRelease -PallowTestAds=true -PallowPlaceholderAssets=true
      - name: Stage first-playable APK
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/first-playable
          cp android/build/outputs/apk/debug/android-debug.apk build/first-playable/deadline-zero-first-playable.apk
          (cd build/first-playable && sha256sum deadline-zero-first-playable.apk > SHA256SUMS.txt)
          (cd build/first-playable && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt)
      - name: Upload first-playable APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deadline-zero-first-playable-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/first-playable/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  android-runtime:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'
      - name: Enable KVM
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm
      - name: Smoke-test Android runtime and capture gameplay
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 35
          arch: x86_64
          profile: pixel_2
          emulator-options: -no-snapshot -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -noaudio -no-boot-anim -camera-back none
          emulator-boot-timeout: 600
          disable-animations: true
          script: |
            set -eu
            adb wait-for-device
            timeout 300s bash -c 'until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r")" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done'
            adb shell input keyevent 82 || true
            timeout 12m gradle :android:connectedDebugAndroidTest
            gradle :android:installDebug :android:installDebugAndroidTest
            mkdir -p build/android-performance build/android-runtime
            timeout 3m adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.deadlinezero.game.android.AndroidGraphicsProfileProbeTest#everyGraphicsProfileAndFrameRateTargetReachesGameScreen com.deadlinezero.game.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner | tee /tmp/android-graphics-profile-matrix.txt
            grep -q 'OK (1 test)' /tmp/android-graphics-profile-matrix.txt
            adb shell ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/graphics-profile-matrix.json
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/graphics-profile-matrix.json build/android-performance/graphics-profile-matrix.json
            test -s build/android-performance/graphics-profile-matrix.json
            python3 -c 'import json; from pathlib import Path; data=json.loads(Path("build/android-performance/graphics-profile-matrix.json").read_text()); rows=data.get("combinations", []); assert data.get("schemaVersion")==1, data; assert len(rows)==12, rows; expected={(q,f) for q in ("LOW","MEDIUM","HIGH","ULTRA") for f in (60,90,120)}; actual={(r["quality"],r["requestedFps"]) for r in rows}; assert actual==expected, (actual,expected); assert all(r["effectiveFps"]==r["requestedFps"] for r in rows), rows; assert all(0.40 <= r["effectiveFxQuality"] <= r["qualityCeiling"] + 0.0001 for r in rows), rows; print("GRAPHICS_PROFILE_MATRIX", json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True))'
            adb shell pm path com.deadlinezero.game | grep -q 'package:'
            adb shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER com.deadlinezero.game | grep -q 'AndroidLauncher'
            adb shell settings put secure immersive_mode_confirmations confirmed || true
            mkdir -p build/android-runtime
            adb logcat -c
            trap 'adb logcat -d -v threadtime > build/android-runtime/logcat.txt 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
            timeout 3m adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.deadlinezero.game.android.AndroidFirstPlayableJourneyTest#traversesContractCombatDefeatAndVictorySettlement com.deadlinezero.game.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner | tee /tmp/first-playable-journey.txt
            grep -q 'OK (1 test)' /tmp/first-playable-journey.txt
            timeout 3m adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.deadlinezero.game.android.AndroidPerformanceProbeTest#recordsLoadedGameplayPerformanceTelemetry com.deadlinezero.game.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner | tee /tmp/android-performance-probe.txt
            grep -q 'OK (1 test)' /tmp/android-performance-probe.txt
            mkdir -p build/android-performance
            adb shell ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/performance-probe.json
            adb pull /sdcard/Android/data/com.deadlinezero.game/files/qa/performance-probe.json build/android-performance/performance-probe.json

      - name: Gate Android runtime crashes and ANRs
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s build/android-runtime/logcat.txt
          python3 tools/android/scan_runtime_log.py             build/android-runtime/logcat.txt             --package com.deadlinezero.game             --json-out build/android-runtime/crash-anr-report.json

      - name: Build Android runtime release evidence
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s build/android-runtime/crash-anr-report.json
          test -s build/android-performance/performance-probe.json
          test -s build/android-performance/performance-stress.json
          test -s build/android-performance/graphics-profile-matrix.json
          python3 tools/android/build_runtime_release_evidence.py             --crash-anr build/android-runtime/crash-anr-report.json             --probe build/android-performance/performance-probe.json             --stress build/android-performance/performance-stress.json             --profiles build/android-performance/graphics-profile-matrix.json             --commit "$GITHUB_SHA"             --json-out build/android-runtime/runtime-release-evidence.json

      - name: Upload Android runtime diagnostics
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: android-runtime-diagnostics-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/android-runtime/logcat.txt
            build/android-runtime/crash-anr-report.json
            build/android-runtime/runtime-release-evidence.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload Android gameplay visual QA
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: android-gameplay-visual-qa-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: build/android-visual-qa/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload Android performance benchmark
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: android-performance-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/android-performance/performance-probe.json
            build/android-performance/performance-stress.json
            build/android-performance/graphics-profile-matrix.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Compare Android performance with main baseline
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE_DIR="build/android-performance-baseline"
          mkdir -p "$BASE_DIR"
          test -s build/android-performance/performance-probe.json
          test -s build/android-performance/performance-stress.json

          baseline_root=""
          baseline_run=""
          for run_id in $(gh run list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --branch main --workflow Verify --status success --limit 20 --json databaseId --jq '.[].databaseId'); do
            rm -rf "$BASE_DIR"/*
            if ! gh run download "$run_id" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern 'android-performance-*' --dir "$BASE_DIR" >/tmp/perf-baseline-download.log 2>&1; then
              continue
            fi
            probe=$(find "$BASE_DIR" -type f -name performance-probe.json | head -n 1 || true)
            stress=$(find "$BASE_DIR" -type f -name performance-stress.json | head -n 1 || true)
            if [ -n "$probe" ] && [ -n "$stress" ]; then
              baseline_root=$(dirname "$probe")
              if [ -s "$baseline_root/performance-stress.json" ]; then
                baseline_run="$run_id"
                break
              fi
            fi
          done

          if [ -z "$baseline_root" ]; then
            echo "PERF_BASELINE skipped: no successful main artifact contains both benchmark scenarios"
            printf '{"comparable":false,"reason":"no complete successful main benchmark artifact found","regressions":[],"metrics":{}}\n' > build/android-performance/probe-regression-report.json
            printf '{"comparable":false,"reason":"no complete successful main benchmark artifact found","regressions":[],"metrics":{}}\n' > build/android-performance/stress-regression-report.json
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "PERF_BASELINE run=$baseline_run root=$baseline_root"
          python3 tools/perf/compare_android_benchmark.py             "$baseline_root/performance-probe.json"             build/android-performance/performance-probe.json             --json-out build/android-performance/probe-regression-report.json
          python3 tools/perf/compare_android_benchmark.py             "$baseline_root/performance-stress.json"             build/android-performance/performance-stress.json             --json-out build/android-performance/stress-regression-report.json

      - name: Upload Android performance regression report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        with:
          name: android-performance-regression-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            build/android-performance/probe-regression-report.json
            build/android-performance/stress-regression-report.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

tasks.register('verifyLocalizationReleaseContract') {
    group = 'verification'
    description = 'Requires the localization readiness contract for production release.'

        if (!contract.isFile()) throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: play/store/LOCALIZATION.md is missing.')
        String text = contract.getText('UTF-8')
        ['Current status', 'Minimum localization architecture', 'Release QA', 'Release rule'].each { required ->
            if (!text.contains('## ' + required)) throw new GradleException('Localization contract missing required section: ' + required)
        }
        if (!text.contains('English-only')) {
            throw new GradleException('Localization contract must explicitly state the current English-only release rule.')
        }
    }
}

        if (!contract.isFile()) throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: play/store/ACCESSIBILITY.md is missing.')
        String text = contract.getText('UTF-8')

        }

tasks.register('verifyPlayReleaseReadinessContract') {
    group = 'verification'
    description = 'Requires the final Play release-readiness matrix and key manual gate sections.'
    doLast {
        File matrix = new File(playStoreDir, 'RELEASE_READINESS.md')
        if (!matrix.isFile()) throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: play/store/RELEASE_READINESS.md is missing.')
        String text = matrix.getText('UTF-8')
        ['Automated gates', 'Manual platform gates', 'Release states', 'Production-ready', 'Rule'].each { required ->
            if (!text.contains('## ' + required) && !text.contains('### ' + required)) {

            }

}

tasks.register('verifyPlayReleaseNotes') {
    group = 'verification'
    description = 'Requires versioned Google Play release notes for the exact appVersion.'
    doLast {
        File notes = new File(playStoreDir, 'RELEASE_NOTES.md')
        if (!notes.isFile()) throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: play/store/RELEASE_NOTES.md is missing.')
        String text = notes.getText('UTF-8')
        String marker = '## ' + appVersion
        int start = text.indexOf(marker)
        if (start < 0) throw new GradleException('Play release notes missing section for appVersion ' + appVersion)
        start += marker.length()
        int end = text.indexOf('\n## ', start)
        if (end < 0) end = text.length()
        String body = text.substring(start, end).trim()
        if (body.isBlank()) throw new GradleException('Play release notes are empty for appVersion ' + appVersion)
        if (body.codePointCount(0, body.length()) > 500) throw new GradleException('Play release notes exceed 500 characters for appVersion ' + appVersion)
    }
}

        String appName = section('App name')
        String shortDescription = section('Short description')
        String fullDescription = section('Full description')
        if (appName != 'Deadline: Zero') throw new GradleException("Play listing app name must be exactly 'Deadline: Zero'.")
        File stringsFile = file('src/main/res/values/strings.xml')
        if (!stringsFile.isFile() || !stringsFile.getText('UTF-8').contains('<string name="app_name">' + appName + '</string>')) {
            throw new GradleException('Play listing app name must match Android @string/app_name.')
        }
        if (appName.codePointCount(0, appName.length()) > 30) throw new GradleException('Play listing app name exceeds 30 characters.')
        if (shortDescription.isBlank() || shortDescription.codePointCount(0, shortDescription.length()) > 80) throw new GradleException('Play listing short description must contain 1..80 characters.')
        if (fullDescription.isBlank() || fullDescription.codePointCount(0, fullDescription.length()) > 4000) throw new GradleException('Play listing full description must contain 1..4000 characters.')
    }
}

tasks.register('verifyPlayStoreAssets') {
    group = 'verification'
    description = 'Validates the final Google Play icon, feature graphic and recommendation-grade phone screenshots.'
    doLast {
        File icon = new File(playStoreDir, 'icon.png')
        def iconImage = readStoreImage(icon)
        if (icon.length() > 1024L * 1024L) {
            throw new GradleException('Play Store icon must be <= 1 MiB: ' + icon)
        }
        if (iconImage.width != 512 || iconImage.height != 512) {
            throw new GradleException("Play Store icon must be exactly 512x512: ${iconImage.width}x${iconImage.height}")
        }

        File feature = new File(playStoreDir, 'feature-graphic.png')
        def featureImage = readStoreImage(feature)
        if (featureImage.width != 1024 || featureImage.height != 500) {
            throw new GradleException("Play feature graphic must be exactly 1024x500: ${featureImage.width}x${featureImage.height}")
        }
        requireNoAlpha(feature, featureImage)

        File screenshotsDir = new File(playStoreDir, 'phone-screenshots')
        if (!screenshotsDir.isDirectory()) {
            throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: play/store/phone-screenshots/ is missing.')
        }
        def screenshots = screenshotsDir.listFiles()?.findAll {
            it.isFile() && it.name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) ==~ /.+\.(png|jpe?g)/
        }?.sort { it.name } ?: []
        if (screenshots.size() < 3) {
            throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: at least 3 recommendation-grade gameplay screenshots are required.')
        }
        screenshots.each { File screenshot ->
            if (screenshot.length() > 8L * 1024L * 1024L) {
                throw new GradleException('Play screenshot must be <= 8 MiB: ' + screenshot)
            }
            def image = readStoreImage(screenshot)
            requireNoAlpha(screenshot, image)
            if (image.width < 1920 || image.height < 1080 || image.width > 3840 || image.height > 3840) {
                throw new GradleException("Play game screenshot must be between 1920x1080 and the Play 3840px maximum dimension: ${screenshot} is ${image.width}x${image.height}")
            }
            if ((long) image.width * 9L != (long) image.height * 16L) {
                throw new GradleException("Play game screenshot must be exact 16:9 landscape: ${screenshot} is ${image.width}x${image.height}")
            }
        }
    }
}

tasks.register('verifyPlayReleaseConfig') {
    group = 'verification'
    description = 'Fails unless the build is configured as a publishable Google Play release.'
    dependsOn 'verifyProductionAssets', 'verifyPlayStoreAssets', 'verifyPlayStoreListing', 'verifyPlayDataSafetyContract', 'verifyPlayConsoleContract', 'verifyPlayReleaseNotes', 'verifyPlayReleaseReadinessContract', 'verifyAccessibilityReleaseContract', 'verifyLocalizationReleaseContract'
    doLast {
        boolean usingTestIds = admobAppId == testAdmobAppId || admobRewardedId == testRewardedId
        if (usingTestIds) {
            throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: production AdMob app and rewarded IDs are required.')
        }
        if (!validAdmobAppId(admobAppId) || !validRewardedId(admobRewardedId)) {
            throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: malformed AdMob IDs. Expected ca-app-pub-################~########## for the app and ca-app-pub-################/########## for rewarded.')
        }
        if (!validPrivacyPolicyUrl(privacyPolicyUrl)) {
            throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: configure -PprivacyPolicyUrl with the real public HTTPS privacy-policy URL used by the in-app Settings screen and Play Console.')
        }
        if (!validPlayGamesAppId(playGamesAppId)) {
            throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: configure -PplayGamesAppId with the numeric Google Play Games Services application ID.')
        }
        if (!releaseStoreExists) {
            throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: upload keystore is missing. Configure -PreleaseStoreFile or DEADLINE_ZERO_KEYSTORE.')
        }
        if (!hasReleaseSigning) {
            throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: upload signing credentials are incomplete. Configure store password, key alias, and key password via Gradle properties or DEADLINE_ZERO_* environment variables.')
        }
        if (!validPlayVersionCode(appVersionCode) || appVersion.isBlank()) {
            throw new GradleException('Play release blocked: appVersionCode must be between 1 and 2100000000 and appVersion must be non-empty.')
        }
    }
}

tasks.register('writePlayReleaseEvidence') {
    group = 'verification'
    description = 'Writes a machine-readable manifest describing the exact Play release configuration.'
    dependsOn 'verifyPlayReleaseConfig'
    doLast {
        File outDir = file("$buildDir/play-release")
        outDir.mkdirs()
        File evidence = new File(outDir, 'release-evidence.json')
        def payload = [
            applicationId: android.defaultConfig.applicationId,
            versionCode: appVersionCode,
            versionName: appVersion,
            minSdk: android.defaultConfig.minSdk.apiLevel,
            targetSdk: android.defaultConfig.targetSdk.apiLevel,
            compileSdk: android.compileSdk,
            playGamesConfigured: validPlayGamesAppId(playGamesAppId),
            privacyPolicyConfigured: validPrivacyPolicyUrl(privacyPolicyUrl),
            productionAdsConfigured: admobAppId != testAdmobAppId && admobRewardedId != testRewardedId,
            releaseSigningConfigured: hasReleaseSigning,
            listingContract: new File(playStoreDir, 'LISTING.md').isFile(),
            dataSafetyContract: new File(playStoreDir, 'DATA_SAFETY.md').isFile(),
            playConsoleContract: new File(playStoreDir, 'PLAY_CONSOLE.md').isFile(),
            generatedAtUtc: java.time.Instant.now().toString()
        ]
        evidence.setText(groovy.json.JsonOutput.prettyPrint(groovy.json.JsonOutput.toJson(payload)) + '\n', 'UTF-8')
        logger.lifecycle('Play release evidence: ' + evidence)
    }
}

tasks.register('bundlePlayRelease') {
    group = 'build'
    description = 'Runs core tests, release lint, production and Play Store validation, then builds the signed Google Play AAB.'
    dependsOn ':core:test', 'lintRelease', 'writePlayReleaseEvidence', 'bundleRelease'
}

tasks.configureEach { task ->
    if (task.name.contains("merge") && task.name.contains("JniLibFolders")) task.dependsOn copyAndroidNatives
    if (task.name == 'bundleRelease') task.mustRunAfter 'verifyPlayReleaseConfig'
    if (task.name in ['bundleRelease', 'assembleRelease']) {
        task.doFirst {
            boolean usingTestIds = admobAppId == testAdmobAppId || admobRewardedId == testRewardedId
            if (usingTestIds && !allowTestAds.get()) {
                throw new GradleException('Release build blocked: configure -PadmobAppId and -PadmobRewardedId with production AdMob IDs. Use -PallowTestAds=true only for CI build verification.')
            }
            if (!validAdmobAppId(admobAppId) || !validRewardedId(admobRewardedId)) {
                throw new GradleException('Release build blocked: malformed AdMob ID format.')
            }
            if (!validPlayVersionCode(appVersionCode)) {
                throw new GradleException('Release build blocked: appVersionCode must be between 1 and 2100000000.')
            }
            def missing = missingProductionAssets()
            if (!missing.isEmpty() && !allowPlaceholderAssets.get()) {
                throw new GradleException('Release build blocked: authored production assets are missing: ' + missing.join(', ') + '. Use -PallowPlaceholderAssets=true only for CI build verification.')
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````json
{
  "version": 1,
  "purpose": "Production contract for Deadline Zero biome environment art.",
  "runtimePolicy": {
    "preferred": "environment/<biome>/<slot>",
    "fallback": "environment/<slot>",
    "bootstrapFallbackAllowedDuringDevelopment": true,
    "releaseGoal": "all 70 biome-specific slots authored and present in art/game.atlas"
  },
  "biomes": [
    {"id":"quarantine_yard","stageStart":1,"palette":"cold industrial steel, emergency red, dirty concrete"},
    {"id":"cinder_foundry","stageStart":10,"palette":"molten orange, furnace red, black steel"},

public void resetTesla(int level) { teslaTimer = Math.max(.75f, 2.7f - level * .28f); }
public void resetMissile(int level) { missileTimer = Math.max(1.1f, 4.4f - level * .42f); }

/** Deterministic boss identity selection that preserves existing rotations and adds Null milestones. */
⋮----
public static BossIdentity forStage(int stage) {
int safeStage = Math.max(1, stage);
if (safeStage >= 40 && Math.floorMod(safeStage - 40, 10) == 0) return FROST_COLOSSUS;
if (safeStage >= 20 && Math.floorMod(safeStage - 20, 5) == 0) return NULL_ARCHON;
⋮----
if (RevenantBossProfile.useForStage(safeStage)) return REVENANT;

killsPerMinute += sample.killsPerMinute();
